Alzoc III.title: Alzoc III/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Empire Reborn

Alzoc III.lead: Alzoc III was the third world in the Alzoc system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a frozen planet, dominated by arctic tundra and frozen wastes. This limited the amount of wildlife on the surface. The sole sentient species native to the planet was the Talz. Tall bipeds covered in gray-white fur, they were notable for their four eyes, an adaptation to dazzling sunlight reflected off snow.

Andasala.title: Andasala/Legends
Andasala.lead: Andasala was a mining world, located on the Llanic Spice Run in the Andasala system near Svivren.

Alassa Major.title: Alassa Major
Alassa Major.lead: Alassa Major was a resort world located along the Enarc Run, known as a major tourist destination for people dwelling in the wealthy core regions.

Algara II.title: Algara II

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Algara II.lead: Algara II, also referred to simply as Algara and Algar, was a planet in the Algaran system of the Lambda sector, located in the Mid Rim with a population of approximately 1 billion. It was also the homeworld of the Xan. Algara II was orbited by four moons: Kevron, Omakaton, Radeon and Tallakron.

Adner.title: Adner
Adner.lead: Adner was a planet located in the Expansion Region's Yataga sector. It had two suns and was a hot world with cold, arid nights. Adner was the homeworld of the sentient Adnerem species. The base unit of the Adnerem society was the steris, a relatively small group of genetically-unbounded individuals.

Anchoron.title: Anchoron
Anchoron.lead: Anchoron was planet in the Anchoron system of the Mayagil sector. The Human Anchoroni were known for their flowery speech, genteel decorum, and politeness.

Alkur.title: Alkur
Alkur.lead: Alkur was the first planet in the Lazerian system. It was located within the Kira sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. Regarded as useless, the planet was a searing hot and desolate rocky world, and it had no moons. Alkur orbited the yellow star known as Lazerian, and was found along the trade routes known as the Harrin Trade Corridor and the Kira Run. At some point, it was explored and mapped by the inhabitants of the planet Lazerian IV.

Acorvus.title: Acorvus
Acorvus.lead: Acorvus, also known as Lazerian III, was the third planet in the Lazerian system, orbiting the yellow star Lazerian. It was located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. Along with the rest of the Lazerian system, Acorvus lay on the Harrin Trade Corridor and Kira Run hyperlanes.

Algara V.title: Algara V

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Algara V.lead: Algara V was the fifth planet in the Algaran system. It was a gas giant with fourteen moons.

Algara VI.title: Algara VI

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Algara VI.lead: Algara VI was the sixth planet in the Algaran system. It was a frozen ice ball.

Aguarl 3.title: Aguarl 3

facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Quarrenese, Mon Calamarian

Aguarl 3.lead: Aguarl 3, or Aguarl III, was a water planet located in the Aguarl system of the Expansion Region.

Alc.title: Alc
Alc.lead: Alc was a jungle planet that was the third world in the Gacerian system. Alc possessed a breathable atmosphere suitable for colonization, but geological surveys reported that the cost of settling the planet would far outweigh any profit to be made from exploiting the planet's resources. It had a single moon.

Almar.title: Almar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Almar.lead: Almar was a tropical planet located in the Elrood sector's Almaran system with beaches, oceans, rain forests, and wide plains of orange grasses. The planet was dedicated to the tourist trade and its surface was called Almar Downside. The planet was orbited by a space station known as Almar Upside, which was considered Almar's capital.

Alis Point.title: Alis Point
Alis Point.lead: Alis Point was a planet in the Tamarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy and the site of a Rebel base during the Galactic Civil War., Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the base had to be evacuated. During the evacuation, Zev Senesca single-handedly held off three TIE/LN starfighters, while the base's unarmed transport fled into hyperspace. Senesca's heroics earned him a spot in the newly founded Rogue Squadron.

Altikar IV.title: Altikar IV
Altikar IV.lead: Altikar IV was a planet in the Altikar system.

Agomar.title: Agomar

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Agomar.lead: Agomar was a planet in the Agomar system of the Seswenna sector. During the Battle of Agomar, the Confederacy of Independent Systems pitted its Droid Army against the Grand Army of the Republic, with the world eventually falling back onto Republic control. Whaladons were found on the planet during the Clone Wars.

Allmittal.title: Allmittal
Allmittal.lead: Allmittal was the eighth planet orbiting the star Striar in the Malastare system. Located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim, it was a gas giant.

Adras.title: Adras
Adras.lead: Adras was a Galactic Empire–held world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Seswenna sector. Shortly before the Battle of Endor, a team of Sullustan Alliance Intelligence officers was tasked with meeting another group of Rebel Alliance agents in order to lead a group of combat starships to join the main Rebel Fleet.

Alphoresis.title: Alphoresis
Alphoresis.lead: Alphoresis was a planet located within the Grumani sector in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy.

Affadar.title: Affadar
Affadar.lead: Affadar was a largely undeveloped planet in the galaxy that was the homeworld of the T'Laeem, a sentient but primitive amphibian species. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire set up a mining operation on the planet.

Arbra.title: Arbra/Legends

facts.terrain: Clearwater lakes, Ice caps, Jungle, Mountains, Rain forests, Underground caves, Volcanoes
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic

Arbra.lead: Arbra was a densely forested planet that became the headquarters of the Rebel Alliance after the evacuation of Golrath Station, around 3 ABY. Home to the lagomorphic Hoojibs, Arbra was once inhabited by an ancient race who had resided in subterranean cities.

Averam.title: Averam/Legends
Averam.lead: Averam was a planet in the Seswenna sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was one of the few planets to openly sympathize with small groups of Rebel Alliance supporters early in the Galactic Civil War.

Arrgaw.title: Arrgaw
Arrgaw.lead: Arrgaw was a major trade planet located in the Expansion Region's Kira sector. A world orbited by impressive trade rings and featuring vast expanses on its surface taken up by warehouses and other corporate structures, Arrgaw lay at the intersection of two important hyperlanes, the Hydian Way and the Harrin Trade Corridor.

Ank Kit'aar.title: Ank Kit'aar
Ank Kit'aar.lead: Ank Kit'aar was a celestial body located in the Ank Kit'aar system, a part of the Druess sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. Not long after the Battle of Yavin, Ank Kit'aar was noted in Rebel Alliance general Airen Cracken's datafile detailing various Rebel operatives as the last known location of Major Kerri Lessev, an agent of the Destabilization branch of the Galactic Empire's Intelligence service tasked with preventing high-ranking Imperial personnel from posing a threat to the reign of Galactic Emperor Palpatine.

Ansarra.title: Ansarra (disambiguation)
Ansarra.lead: Ansarra can refer to:, Attack on Ansarra Rebel base, an attack by a star destroyer on the base, Ansarra Rebel base, a Rebel Alliance starfighter base, Ansarra system, a system in the Mid Rim

Atrakus.title: Atrakus
Atrakus.lead: Atrakus was a world located in the Atrakus system, a part of the Mikaster sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. During the Clone Wars, the Jedi watchgroup People's Inquest resumed broadcasting HoloNet transmissions after a temporary shutdown by the Galactic Republic's HoloCommunications Commission.

Arkonne III.title: Arkonne III
Arkonne III.lead: Arkonne III was an Imperial planet in the Arkonne system inhabited by Humans such as business rivals Divina Quri Adner and Phean Tic'Karcta. Phean sabotaged Divina's vehicle, killing her. Wilek Nereus, Divina's beau, put an Imperial bounty on Phean, whom he personally killed.

Arbran VI.title: Arbran VI
Arbran VI.lead: Arbran VI was a moonless ice planet that occupied the sixth orbit around the star Arbran. It was the outermost planet in the Arbran system, which was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Arbran V.title: Arbran V
Arbran V.lead: Arbran V was the fifth planet in orbit around the star Arbran. It was the second of two gas giants in the Arbran system, located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was orbited by eleven moons.

Arbran IV.title: Arbran IV
Arbran IV.lead: Arbran IV was the fourth planet orbiting the star Arbran in the Arbran system. A gas giant with eight moons, it was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Arbran III.title: Arbran III
Arbran III.lead: Arbran III was the third planet in orbit around the star Arbran. It was located in the Arbran system in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Arbran III's surface consisted of ice, and it was orbited by two moons.

Arbran I.title: Arbran I
Arbran I.lead: Arbran I was a rocky, moonless planet that orbited the star Arbran. It was the innermost planet in the Arbran system, which was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Ansillivog.title: Ansillivog

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Ansillivog.lead: Ansillivog was a planet in the Ansillivog system of the Expansion Region.

Ansek.title: Ansek
Ansek.lead: Ansek was a planet in the Mid Rim's Ansek system.

Anstares VI.title: Anstares VI
Anstares VI.lead: Anstares VI, also known as Anstares, was a Mid Rim gas giant located in the Juvex sector. It was orbited by three planetary rings and eight moons, the latter of which were a popular destination for visitors from both the Senex-Juvex region and the wider galaxy.

Argus.title: Argus
Argus.lead: Argus was a Human-inhabited planet in the Argus system. When the New Order was instituted, Argus's Celestial School of Spaceflight Engineering was closed down. At least one of the school's professors, Maggis, became a teacher at the Imperial Naval Academy on Imperial Center, rather than be blacklisted from ever teaching again.

Aquilaris Minor.title: Aquilaris Minor
Aquilaris Minor.lead: Aquilaris Minor, or simply Aquilaris, was a planet in the Grumani sector of the Outer Rim.

Anthus.title: Anthus
Anthus.lead: Anthus was a planet in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim.

Atron.title: Atron
Atron.lead: Atron was a planet located within the Atron system of the Mid Rim's Senex sector.

Athallia.title: Athallia
Athallia.lead: Athallia was an astronomical object located in the Athallia system. It was a part of the Athallia sector, within the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. Kalarcha served as Athallia's capital. Athallia shared its name with the courier starship Athallian Messenger.

Bith.title: Bith/Legends
Bith.lead: Bith were a peaceful, highly evolved craniopod species native to the planet Clak'dor VII. Fully adapted to a civilized, high-technology lifestyle, Bith were found galaxy-wide at all levels of society, most notably as engineers, scientists, intellectuals, consultants, and musicians.

Behenui.title: Behenui
Behenui.lead: Behenui was a planet in the fifth orbit around the star Beheboth. It was the only gas giant in the Beheboth system, which was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Behenui itself was circled by nine moons.

Bortras.title: Bortras
Bortras.lead: Bortras was a tranquil world of lush valleys and fertile landscapes in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was known as the home planet of Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth.

Beheboth.title: Beheboth

facts.terrain: Deserts, Mountainous, Outpost towns, Shallow salt lakes
facts.government: Loose network of democratic town councils
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Beheboth.lead: Beheboth was a desert planet located in the Sanbra sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Beheboth was home to the Tirrith, a unique empathic gaseous culture of hive-minded sentient particles, which thrived even among the planet's inhospitably arid and dry climate. Bothans, and later Humans, settled Beheboth during the Republic era, dotting the world with moisture farms and small towns.

Aviles Prime.title: Aviles Prime
Aviles Prime.lead: Aviles Prime was an astronomical object located in the Aviles Prime system, within the Hythrope sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a conference attended by Oviedo Engineering director Lorca Oviedo.

Boden.title: Boden
Boden.lead: Boden was a planet in the Boden system. Some time before 0 ABY, Leger DeMain once helped Airen Cracken escape capture during an Imperial occupation of the planet.

Belorphyn.title: Belorphyn

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Belorphyn.lead: Belorphyn was the ninth planet in the Derilyn system. It was an inhospitable ice ball without moons with an oblong orbit (due to Serrata's influence). For a portion of its "year", it actually was closer to Deril than Serrata.

Boranall.title: Boranall
Boranall.lead: Boranall was a temperate world in the Mid Rim. In 3640 BBY, Boranall was attacked by the Sith Empire warship Ascendant Spear in order to suppress rebellion in the Boranall system.

Bofa II.title: Bofa II
Bofa II.lead: Bofa II was a planet that housed an Imperial Cargo Transfer Area during the Galactic Civil War and was the distribution site of Imperial surveillance droids. The BFF-1 bulk freighter Libom was captured there.

Besn.title: Besn
Besn.lead: Besn was a celestial body located in the Besn system, a part of the Mayagil sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the origin point of the art form known as participlays, which the Art group of the Coalition for Progress of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order reviewed and judged.

Bengely.title: Bengely
Bengely.lead: Bengely was a seedy world with an underworld that had a dangerous reputation.

Baes Logia.title: Baes Logia
Baes Logia.lead: Baes Logia was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Baes Logia system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Quence sector. At one point during the Galactic Civil War, the Carosite Rebel Alliance medic Tamo Lan served in a short campaign on Baes Logia. During that same conflict, a trio of Rebel operatives once attempted to lure a general of the Galactic Empire into a trap.

Berusa.title: Berusa
Berusa.lead: Berusa was the first planet in the Garos system. It was located in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim.

Bannistar Station planetoid.title: Bannistar Station planetoid
Bannistar Station planetoid.lead: This unidentified planet housed Bannistar Station, an Imperial refueling station. The station's refineries were placed on the planet's surface, while the rest of the station was located high above. During the Attack on Bannistar Station, much of the station was destroyed and at least one Star Destroyer crashed on the planet.

Bormus.title: Bormus/Legends
Bormus.lead: Bormus was a planet orbited by a Gran-run naval testing facility.

Behpour.title: Behpour/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Techno Union

Behpour.lead: Behpour was a small and rocky planet in the Naboo system, too inhospitable to sustain any life despite having a breathable atmosphere.

Bingsang.title: Bingsang
Bingsang.lead: Bingsang was the sixth planet orbiting the star Striar in the Malastare system. Located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim, it was a gas giant.

Big One.title: Big One/Legends
Big One.lead: The Big One was a moon-sized asteroid located in the Hoth asteroid field. During the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, the smuggler Han Solo used a large crater within this asteroid to hide his starship, the Millennium Falcon, from pursuing Imperial forces under the command of the Dark Lord Darth Vader. However, Solo and his Rebel companions, including Princess Leia Organa, were surprised to learn that the large asteroid crater was actually the gullet of an enormous space slug.

Bomodon.title: Bomodon
Bomodon.lead: Bomodon was a terrestrial planet located in the Bomodon system, a part of the Churba sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the sentient Bomodon species.

Baarstal.title: Baarstal
Baarstal.lead: Baarstal was an astronomical object that was located within the Baarstal system in the Outer Rim Territories. At some point shortly before the fall of the Galactic Republic, a small incident occurred near Baarstal. Onboard the star ship of a certain woman, an M38 droid went haywire and began damaging the vessel. Before she realized what was happening, the droid had wrecked the engines and several other systems before leaving the ship and disappearing into the jungle. Later, a trader near Naboo picked up a distress signal from Baarstal.

Bpfassh.title: Bpfassh

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Bpfassh.lead: Bpfassh was an arid double planet in the Sluis sector orbited by a complicated system of moons, located near Praesitlyn and Sluis Van. It was the homeworld of the Bpfasshi.

Brenu.title: Brenu
Brenu.lead: Brenu was the second celestial body in orbit around the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, which was situated in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Classified as a sungrazer planetoid, Brenu did not have any moons.

Chommell Minor.title: Chommell Minor/Legends
Chommell Minor.lead: Captain Ric Olié of Bravo Squadron was battle-hardened at Chommell Minor.

Bridin Anchorage.title: Bridin Anchorage
Bridin Anchorage.lead: Bridin Anchorage, originally called Gallienis IV, was once a lush, tourist world in the Portmoak sector. It was renamed Quarlo Bridin, a disgraced politician who took over the world shortly after Thrawn's death. Once his planet's immediate safety was secured, Bridin used his Hutt friends to coerce the passage of a battery of ordinances making a variety of formerly criminal operations legal. This, in turn, resulted in a flood of criminal enterprises to the planet, including Manliss Enterprise.

Caltinia.title: Caltinia
Caltinia.lead: Caltinia was a lush planet that was the homeworld of House Elegin, famous for its hundreds of dueling fields surrounded by numerous mausoleums, temples, and museums celebrating and mourning epic duels of the past. It was located in the Senex-Juvex's Senex sector in the Mid Rim and Western Reaches of the galaxy. Caltinia was once visited by Lando Calrissian.

Brevost.title: Brevost
Brevost.lead: Brevost was a planet in the Brevost system of the Expansion Region. It was on the Harrin Trade Corridor between the Krann system and the Cerenia system.

Brintooin.title: Brintooin

facts.terrain: Plains, Deserts, Marshes, Scrub, Scattered woods, Other flatlands

Brintooin.lead: Brintooin was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Seswenna sector. The planet's terrain included plains, marshes, and deserts, as well as scrub and woodlands. By the time of the Battle of Turak IV between the Galactic Empire and Rebel Alliance, Brintooin was selected as the baseworld for the Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit and was populated by Humans fiercely loyal to the Empire.

Ch'manss.title: Ch'manss system/Legends
Ch'manss.lead: The Ch'manss system was a star system located on the Gevarno Loop within the Mid Rim. Its inhabitants were Loyalists to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Bront.title: Bront
Bront.lead: Bront was a planet located within the Bront system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Svivreni sector. At some point by 0 ABY, the Human male Graf Yonna and his family lived on Bront.

Chryya.title: Chryya
Chryya.lead: Chryya was a planet with a thriving spice business. It was located in the Mid Rim, on the Hydian Way near the border of the Outer Rim Territories. Darth Maul was once sent on a mission to this planet by Darth Sidious to convince the miners to sell to the Trade Federation. Maul's failure to convince them was his only failure prior to the Invasion of Naboo.

Callos.title: Callos
Callos.lead: Callos was a planet of the Brema sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was once teeming with animal and plant life, until it was devastated by the Galactic Empire in 3 BBY.

Byrsym.title: Byrsym
Byrsym.lead: Byrsym was a planet that was located in the Mid Rim Territories.

Bubbok.title: Bubbok
Bubbok.lead: Bubbok was a terrestrial planet in the Dagobah system, located in the Outer Rim Territories' Sluis sector. It had three moons and occupied the fourth orbital position around the star Darlo. Along with the rest of the star system, Bubbok was situated on the hyperlane known as the Rimma Trade Route. Bubbok's surface consisted of ice, and it featured a frigid environment.

Chunno-ka-Alee.title: Chunno-ka-Alee
Chunno-ka-Alee.lead: Chunno-ka-Alee was the third planet orbiting the star Shadda in the Shadda-Bi-Boran system. Located in the Toblain sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a barren rock.

Chaila.title: Chaila
Chaila.lead: Chaila was the second planet in the Garos system. It was located in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim.

Cirtappa.title: Cirtappa
Cirtappa.lead: Cirtappa was a planet in the Alui sector of the Mid Rim.

Chelleya.title: Chelleya
Chelleya.lead: Chelleya was an astronomical object located within the Chelleya system of the Outer Rim Territories' Seswenna sector.

Carreras Major.title: Carreras Major
Carreras Major.lead: Carreras Major was a backwater planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Bromlarch.title: Bromlarch/Legends
Bromlarch.lead: Bromlarch was a planet in the Mid Rim's Vish sector that was linked to a planetary aqueduct system prior to 20 BBY. Naboo Senator Padmé Amidala and Scipio Senator Rush Clovis jointly prepared a Galactic Senate hearing to rescue Bromlarch's system, which was effective in saving a population from drought and famine.

Cerroban.title: Cerroban
Cerroban.lead: Cerroban was a world located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Following the Battle of Yavin, the world was scouted by Rebel Alliance forces seeking for a new base. Cerroban was a waterless and airless rocky world that was pounded by asteroids regularly.

Clak'dor VII.title: Clak'dor VII/Legends

facts.routes: Monedes'mai Hypercanal, Rimma Trade Route, Seswenna Expansion
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Eriadu Authority, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Clak'dor VII.lead: Clak'dor VII, also known as Bith, was a small planet orbiting the large white star Colu in the Colu system of the Outer Rim Territories on the Rimma Trade Route. It was a long-time member of the Galactic Republic and was also the homeworld of the Bith species.

Clak'dor IV.title: Clak'dor IV

facts.routes: Monedes'mai Hypercanal, Rimma Trade Route, Seswenna Expansion

Clak'dor IV.lead: Clak'dor IV was a Bith colony world. Most of the Y'bith left Clak'dor VII and resettled here, in the city of New Nozho.

Courkrus.title: Courkrus
Courkrus.lead: Courkrus, also called Khuiumin 4, or simply Khuiumin, was the primary planet of the Khuiumin system in the Khuiumin sector, located in the Outer Rim.

Cmaoli Di.title: Cmaoli Di/Legends
Cmaoli Di.lead: Cmaoli Di was a world in the Brema sector. Between 3701 BBY and 3699 BBY, the Hydian Way was charted through the planet as part of the Seswenna Expansion. Cmaoli Di was known to receive broadcasts from the Brema News service.

Dargul.title: Dargul
Dargul.lead: Dargul was a planet located within the Darglum system of the Mid Rim with pampered nobility.

Dborian.title: Dborian
Dborian.lead: Dborian, also known as Lazerian V, was the fifth planet in the Lazerian system, orbiting the yellow star Lazerian. It was located within the Kira sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. Along with the rest of the Lazerian system, Dborian lay on the Harrin Trade Corridor and Kira Run hyperlanes.

Clak'dor I.title: Clak'dor I

facts.routes: Monedes'mai Hypercanal, Rimma Trade Route, Seswenna Expansion

Clak'dor I.lead: Clak'dor I was originally the innermost planet in the Colu system of the Mayagil sector until it was consumed by Colu around 8000 BBY.

Clak'dor II.title: Clak'dor II

facts.routes: Monedes'mai Hypercanal, Rimma Trade Route, Seswenna Expansion

Clak'dor II.lead: Clak'dor II was the second-innermost planet within the Colu system, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. After the destruction of Clak'dor I, the world became the star system's innermost.

Clak'dor III.title: Clak'dor III

facts.routes: Monedes'mai Hypercanal, Rimma Trade Route, Seswenna Expansion

Clak'dor III.lead: Clak'dor III was a planet in the Colu system.

Clak'dor V.title: Clak'dor V/Legends

facts.routes: Monedes'mai Hypercanal, Rimma Trade Route, Seswenna Expansion

Clak'dor V.lead: Clak'dor V was a gas giant planet and former prison colony in the Colu system.

Demos Four.title: Demos Four
Demos Four.lead: Demos Four was a planet with two moons, located in the Mid Rim. It was located on the Dustig Trace, nearby to the Tyus Cluster.

Cuirilla.title: Cuirilla
Cuirilla.lead: Cuirilla was a celestial body located in the Cuirilla system, a part of the Mbandamonte sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It shared its name with the tug model known as the VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug.

Daemen.title: Daemen
Daemen.lead: Daemen was a planet on the Rimma Trade Route in the Expansion Region. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin in 1 BBY, the Camblian Order from the Outer Rim world of Eedoq sent 309 prospective students to be enrolled at the Clarion Scholars Academy on the planet Daemen. However, their transport ship, the Lark, was destroyed during the journey by the Imperial pilot Tars Nandy, resulting in the deaths of all 309 children.

Demnadi.title: Demnadi
Demnadi.lead: Demnadi was a Mid Rim planet located in the Far Xandil sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a planet-wide riot, believed by the Imperial Governor Cathers to have been instigated by local Rebel Alliance factions, erupted at Demnadi. In response, the Empire dispatched the CompForce Demnadi Relief Operation, which consisted of just one man, Major Fenris Sarhl, to pacify the planet.

Cogalle.title: Cogalle
Cogalle.lead: Cogalle was the fourth planet orbiting the star Striar in the Malastare system. Located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim, it was a toxic waterworld.

Dar.title: Dar/Legends
Dar.lead: Dar was a male Trandoshan hunter who was alive during the Clone Wars. He was the son of Garnac, the leader of a group of hunters that abducted Ahsoka Tano on Felucia.

Corrdair.title: Corrdair
Corrdair.lead: Corrdair was a planet located in the Corrdair system of the Hevvrol sector in the Mid Rim. The Battle of Corrdair took place there.

Deersheba.title: Deersheba (disambiguation)
Deersheba.lead: Deersheba may refer to one of the following:

D'Qar.title: D'Qar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Occlusion Zone, Trailing Sectors
facts.affiliation: Partisans, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Resistance

D'Qar.lead: D'Qar was a verdant planet located in the Ileenium system of the Outer Rim Territories. By the thirtieth year after the formation of the New Republic, the planet was the location of the headquarters of the Resistance, a private paramilitary force formed by Senator Leia Organa to combat the growing threat of the First Order, a self-proclaimed continuation of the Galactic Empire.

Crait.title: Crait

facts.terrain: Briny seas, Canyons, Mountains, Salt flats
facts.affiliation: Bail Organa's resistance movement, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Resistance

Crait.lead: Crait was a small salty mineral planet located in a remote sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square N-17 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Covered with a layer of white salt over its red soil, the planet once hosted a Rebel Alliance outpost during their early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Many years later, the uninhabited planet became a haven for Leia Organa's Resistance, which resulted in a battle between the Resistance and the First Order on the planet's surface.

Derenath.title: Derenath
Derenath.lead: Derenath was a barren, icy planet that occupied the sixth orbit around the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, a star system located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors in the Outer Rim Territories. Derenath had no moons.

Druckenwell.title: Druckenwell/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.terrain: Urban, Industrial, Wetlands, Oceans, Some sparse parkland
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance …

Druckenwell.lead: Druckenwell was an industrial world in the Doldur sector, on the Corellian Run. A Trade Federation world, it was loyal to the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. It was best known for a BlasTech weapons manufacturing complex that was located there.

Dorvalla.title: Dorvalla/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Galactic Empire

Dorvalla.lead: Dorvalla was a lommite mining world, located in the Videnda sector, controlled by Dorvalla Mining and initially independent of the Galactic Republic. In 33 BBY, it was the scene of a battle between the Trade Federation and the Nebula Front. Subsequently, it was taken over by the Trade Federation.

Doldur.title: Doldur

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Doldur.lead: Doldur was the Imperial-controlled sector capital of Doldur sector. Imperial Moff Eisen Kerioth considered it his personal territory and sponsored research of an antiblaster energy shield.

Derilyn.title: Derilyn

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Derilyn.lead: Derilyn was a planet in the Elrood sector on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route.

Drong II.title: Drong II
Drong II.lead: Drong II was a planet in the Drong system that was home to the llwelkyn predator.

Dorvalla IV.title: Dorvalla IV

facts.affiliation: Dorvalla Mining, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Dorvalla IV.lead: Dorvalla IV was a world controlled by Dorvalla Mining. It was the planet beyond their main base, Dorvalla. It was apparently inhabitable by humanoids; whether it actually was is unknown.

Ec Pand.title: Ec Pand
Ec Pand.lead: Ec Pand was a Mid Rim world that was located within the Ado sector, and was one of the Induparan Crown Worlds.

Desstious.title: Desstious
Desstious.lead: Desstious was a world located in the Desstious system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Human male Par Lankin, who was born in 50 BBY. Lankin's homeworld was noted in Wanted by Cracken, a datafile that served as a compilation of reports on various threats to the New Republic and was published in 7 ABY.

Dragos VI.title: Dragos VI
Dragos VI.lead: Dragos VI was a planet scouted by Dantaree for the Rebel Alliance.

Dzass IV.title: Dzass IV
Dzass IV.lead: Dzass IV was an astronomical object that occupied the fourth orbital position within the Dzass system. It was a part of the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Denbo.title: Denbo
Denbo.lead: Denbo was a planet that hosted the Viraxo 54 orbital facility, a cargo transfer and storage station operated by Viraxo Shipping.

Derricon.title: Derricon
Derricon.lead: Derricon was a Rebel Alliance aligned planet during the Galactic Civil War.

Droecil.title: Droecil
Droecil.lead: Droecil was a planet home to a Rebel Alliance cell.

Ealor.title: Ealor
Ealor.lead: Ealor was a temperate planet in the Bysis system of the Outer Rim Territories' Parmic sector. It was covered with grasslands and temperate forests.

Eczar.title: Eczar
Eczar.lead: Eczar was an astronomical object located within the Eczar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Seswenna sector. The Filar-Nitzan infiltrator Vacander maintained a bank account on Eczar by 2 ABY.

Destreg II.title: Destreg II
Destreg II.lead: Destreg II was a planet in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the Outer Rim.

Draik 4.title: Draik 4
Draik 4.lead: Draik 4 was a planet located in the Mid Rim. The Imperial-run Damorian Repair Yard was nearby.

Dorenia.title: Dorenia system/Legends
Dorenia.lead: The Dorenia system was located in the Mayagil sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the origin point of the musical instrument known as the Dorenian Beshniquel.

Derf.title: Derf system/Legends
Derf.lead: The Derf system was a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Sluis sector. It shared its name with the Derf Chapter of the Max Rebo Fan Club.

Falleen.title: Falleen/Legends
Falleen.lead: The Falleen were the indigenous reptilian sentient species of the planet Falleen.

Eos.title: Eos
Eos.lead: Eos was a dark mineral-rich volcanic planet in the Outer Rim Territories that hosted a large droid foundry belonging to the Trade Federation.

Farstine.title: Farstine

facts.routes: Five Veils Route, Triellus Trade Route

Farstine.lead: Farstine was a planet within the Farstine system, situated in the Mid Rim's Ryndellian sector. The planet was located on two major hyperlanes: the Five Veils Route, which connected the Mid Rim to the Svivreni and Skine sectors in the Outer Rim Territories, and the Triellus Trade Route, which spanned a large section of the Outer Rim within the Slice. Farstine possessed a methane atmosphere, requiring oxygen-breathing species to use breath masks for survival on the surface.

Eiattu 6.title: Eiattu 6

facts.affiliation: Royal House of Eiattu, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Priamsta, Eriadu Authority, New Republic

Eiattu 6.lead: Eiattu 6 was a planet in the Ado sector of the Mid Rim. Commonly called simply Eiattu by its inhabitants, it was ruled by a monarchy.

Elshandruu Pica.title: Elshandruu Pica
Elshandruu Pica.lead: Elshandruu Pica was a planet in the Elshandruu system of the Quence sector, in the Outer Rim.

Edan II.title: Edan II/Legends

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Edan II.lead: Edan II was a planet in the Edan system. Although Edan Base was taken out by the Galactic Empire, the Rebel Alliance regained the planet, defeating the Imperial Dark Jedi natives Teles Jalahafi and Shela Jalahafi.

Engebo V.title: Engebo V
Engebo V.lead: Engebo V was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories with constant winds.

Epsi Nadir.title: Epsi Nadir

facts.affiliation: The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers

Epsi Nadir.lead: Epsi Nadir was an Expansion Region planet located in the Epsi Collective sector. It was purchased by the arms dealer group known as the Most Honourable Guild of Armourers, which established an auction house there. The bounty hunter Dej Vennor at one point acquired the interrogation droid IT-904 at the auction house.

Empartheca.title: Empartheca system/Legends
Empartheca.lead: The Empartheca system was a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Hook Nebula. Prengahl Kreen, a third-generation Twi'lek, was one of the most successful arms dealers there during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.

Erinar.title: Erinar

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Lipsec Run, Nothoiin Corridor, Rimma Trade Route, Senex Trace, Yankirk Route

Erinar.lead: Erinar was a volcanic rock planet in the Eriadu system, located in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Erinar was circled by one moon and itself occupied the third orbital position around the star Eriadu. Along with its star system, it was located on the hyperspace routes known as the Hydian Way, the Lipsec Run, the Nothoiin Corridor, the Rimma Trade Route, the Senex Trace, and the Yankirk Route.

Erep.title: Erep
Erep.lead: Erep was the second planet in the Naboo system. It had one moon.

Elpoor.title: Elpur
Elpoor.lead: Elpur was the first planet within the Ropagi system, situated in the Kira sector of the Expansion Region. It was a desolate searing rock.

Farfeld II.title: Farfeld II
Farfeld II.lead: Farfeld II was an astronomical object in the Farfeld system. It was the site of an Imperial System Patrol Squadron base guarded by the CR90 corvettes Olrac Etnom and Cutlass until it was destroyed by Red Squadron B-wings.

Eedoq.title: Eedoq
Eedoq.lead: Eedoq was a world in the Outer Rim's Tantra sector. Eedoq was the homeworld of the Camblian Order, which, shortly before the Battle of Yavin around in 1 BBY, sent 309 prospective students to be enrolled at the Clarion Scholars Academy on the planet Daemen. However, their transport ship, the Lark, was destroyed during the journey by the Imperial pilot Tars Nandy, resulting in the deaths of all 309 children.

Eredin.title: Eredin
Eredin.lead: Eredin was an ice-bound planet that was located in the Astal sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Fendry.title: Fendry
Fendry.lead: During the Galactic Civil War, it was the battlefield of the Battle of Fendry.

Eirrauus.title: Eirrauus
Eirrauus.lead: Eirrauus was a desert world populated by the Eirraucs. It was located in the Quence sector of the galaxy.

Farboon.title: Farboon
Farboon.lead: Farboon was a planet that appeared green-blue from space. It was the site where Maarek Stele, a TIE/LN starfighter pilot, rescued Imperial Admiral Mordon's shuttle from a Rebel attack of X-wing and Y-wing fighters.

Figili.title: Figili
Figili.lead: Figili was the first planet orbiting the star Shadda in the Shadda-Bi-Boran system. Located in the Toblain sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a desert world.

Espirion.title: Espirion (species)/Legends
Espirion.lead: Espirion was a species that included the legendary Jedi Handi. During the rule of the Eternal Empire, researchers claimed to have discovered Handi's lost resting place.

Gammalin.title: Gammalin
Gammalin.lead: Gammalin was a planet in the Vish sector of the Mid Rim. Its populace was wiped out by the Emperor's Plague. Unknowingly released by Fonterrat, he had brought it from an Imperial storehouse and booby-trapped by Nolaa Tarkona. After poisoning the populace of Gammalin, he was arrested and died of malnutrition, as his captors died of the plague.

Gavens.title: Gavens
Gavens.lead: Gavens was a human-inhabited planet located in the Expansion Region's Gavens system. It was the birthplace of Akanah Norand Goss Pell. Its capital city was Torlas.

Golrath.title: Golrath/Legends

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Golrath.lead: Golrath was a planet located in the Sanbra sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A heavily volcanic world, Golrath was at one point home to a magma smelting industry that was largely abandoned after the planet underwent a phase of global cooling—the planet's volcanic bedrock had unique light-absorbing properties that allowed it to play back images it collected in a manner similar to a holoprojector. In 3 ABY, an abandoned magma smelting plant on Golrath became home to Golrath Station, a temporary Rebel Alliance base at the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Godo.title: Godo
Godo.lead: Godo was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the source of flame gems. The world was saved by Lando Calrissian and Han Solo. The Godoans refused to save Lando from a deadly disease in return until the Alliance of Free Planets threatened to attack Godo.

Geridard.title: Geridard
Geridard.lead: Geridard was a Mid Rim world in the Geridard system of Doldur sector. It was known for its retirement and medical facilities, catering to renowned corporate officials. Augusta I'att was to enter the Geridard Convalescent Center, though she was executed before ever attending.

Friijillis.title: Friijillis
Friijillis.lead: Friijillis was a planet in the Dail sector. The Hutt-sponsored news network, the Friij News Services—the clearing house of illegal information and data replication, controlled by the Tenloss Criminal Syndicate—was based on this planet.

Granicus.title: Granicus
Granicus.lead: Granicus was the name of an Imperial throneworld, in the Granicus system, a gas giant with gray cirrus methane clouds. The galactic capital was a floating city.

Gosho IV.title: Gosho IV
Gosho IV.lead: Gosho IV was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Greater Galam.title: Greater Galam
Greater Galam.lead: Greater Galam was a gas giant and the third planet orbiting the star Lan in the Outer Rim's Lan system. It had sixteen moons and was situated within the Hook Nebula. Greater Galam and its star system were discovered by the Galactic Republic around 1300 BBY. The Human mining conglomerate Gaminne Group, Inc. purchased the system's mining rights from the sentient Qieg species native to the system's fourth planet, Lan Barell.

Garrthinius.title: Garrthinius
Garrthinius.lead: Garrthinius was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Steniplis sector that was under the control of the Galactic Empire by the time of the Battle of Endor. Although the population was largely sympathetic to anti-Imperial activity, the insurgents' efforts to resist Imperial occupation were disorganized. Several Rebel Alliance agents traveled to the planet, where they eventually turned the various revolutionary groups into a force capable of overthrowing the Imperial government.

Graveyard of Lost Ships.title: Graveyard of Lost Ships
Graveyard of Lost Ships.lead: The Graveyard of Lost Ships was a collection of starships which were drawn into orbit around a collapsed dwarf star by Doctor Arakkus. The Graveyard consisted of five interconnected rings of ships all of which had been lured to the Graveyard with distress calls, in an attempt to make others suffer as he had suffered. The ships which were drawn to the Graveyard by the gravitational pull of the dwarf star. Incapable of escaping its grasp, the ships slowly began to plunge into the star, while most of the crews went insane and committed suicide.

Gactimus' Halo.title: Gactimus' Halo

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Sharlissian Trade Corridor

Gactimus' Halo.lead: Gactimus' Halo was an asteroid belt orbiting the star Triton in the Triton system. It was located in the Mayagil sector of the Outer Rim, it was situated beyond the planet Triton.

Gandalla.title: Gandalla
Gandalla.lead: Gandalla was a planet located in the Boeus sector of the Expansion Region.

Gallion.title: Gallion
Gallion.lead: Gallion was a planet that was located in the Grumani sector. Gallion was one of the largest rocky planets in the sector and had low gravity, allowing lifeforms on the world to develop to titanic sizes.

Fostin.title: Fostin
Fostin.lead: Fostin was a black-colored world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by at least nine moons, including Fostin Nine.

Fiviune.title: Fiviune
Fiviune.lead: Fiviune was a world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was considered to be a dead world and its surface consisted of rocky plates and spiky crags. However, there were rumors that Fiviune had once been ruled by an ancient civilization, which had been destroyed.

Garis.title: Garis

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Garis.lead: Garis was a planet in the Tamarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Garcornia.title: Garcornia
Garcornia.lead: Garcornia was a celestial body located in the Garcornia system, a part of the Mid Rim's Ado sector. It was the origin point of Garcornian spice. By 3638 BBY, multiple manufacturing plants were situated on Garcornia. That year, mass riots took place on the celestial body, leaving dozens of the factories in a state of disarray.

Frong.title: Frong
Frong.lead: Frong was a planet located in the Outer Rim that was the homeworld of the Frong species. It was situated in the Frong system in the Ojoster sector, in grid square N-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Haruun Kal.title: Haruun Kal/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Haruun Kal.lead: The planet Haruun Kal (Above the Clouds in Basic, also known as Haruun Kul or Al'Har I), located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim on the Gevarno Loop, was the homeworld of the famed Jedi Master Mace Windu. Its capital was Pelek Baw.

Huip.title: Huip
Huip.lead: Huip was the innermost celestial body orbiting the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, a star system located in the Sanbra sector, one of the Trailing Sectors in the Outer Rim Territories. Alongside its outer neighbor Brenu, Huip was classified as a sungrazer planetoid and had no moons.

Hebeth.title: Hebeth
Hebeth.lead: Hebeth was a moonless planet that occupied the third orbit around the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, which was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Hebeth's surface consisted of molten rock.

H'nemthe.title: H'nemthe/Legends
H'nemthe.lead: H'nemthe was the homeworld of the H'nemthe species.

Hockaleg.title: Hockaleg
Hockaleg.lead: Hockaleg was a planet in the Patriim system. The Tarkin superweapon was built in orbit of Hockaleg, with the construction crew living in a spaceport town on the world in between work shifts. Citizens of this world worshiped the deity Holy Jaf.

Harpori.title: Harpori
Harpori.lead: Harpori was a planet that was located in the Druess sector near the Balowa system within the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It hosted a Duros colony that was wiped out by Kaox Krul in 1000 BBY, shortly before the Battles of Ruusan.

Heriston.title: Heriston
Heriston.lead: Heriston was a planet in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Indupar.title: Indupar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Indupar.lead: Indupar was a Mid Rim world in Ado sector. It was the capital of the Induparan Crown Worlds. It was ruled by the Induparan Monarchy and House Indupar, including King Dahon Indupar during the New Order. During the Clone Wars, Indupar was located within Separatist space. The Imperial Governor of the Induparan Crown Worlds was Mirash Peet. Imperial Commodore Soleric commanded the 16th Escort Force, escorting merchant convoys through the Induparan to protect them from the Free Lance.

Jaroona.title: Jaroona

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Lipsec Run, Nothoiin Corridor, Rimma Trade Route, Senex Trace, Yankirk Route

Jaroona.lead: Jaroona was a volcanic rock planet located in the Eriadu system in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Jaroona and its star system were located on the hyperspace routes known as the Hydian Way, the Lipsec Run, the Nothoiin Corridor, the Rimma Trade Route, the Senex Trace, and the Yankirk Route. The planet had no moons and occupied the second orbital position around the star Eriadu.

Hyrol Preen Beta.title: Hyrol Preen Beta
Hyrol Preen Beta.lead: Hyrol Preen Beta was a planet in the Outer Rim. Its populace was wiped out by Imperial Storm commandos and ZQ infantry droids because of suspected Rebel activity. A spacer, Johin, brought news of the devastation.

Hythrope IV.title: Hythrope IV
Hythrope IV.lead: Hythrope IV was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Hythrope system, a part of the Hythrope sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It was the site of a building where, at one point by the time that shortly followed the Battle of Yavin, the Advisory Council of the Rebel Alliance was present.

Insta-7.title: Insta-7
Insta-7.lead: Insta-7 was a planet in the Insta system where a warrant was issued for the arrest of Glott.

Ifron.title: Ifron/Legends
Ifron.lead: Ifron was a planet located in the Thuris sector of the Outer Rim. Mara Jade visited the seedy Bovris Tapcafe on Ifron during her search for Dequc.

Ihopek.title: Ihopek
Ihopek.lead: Ihopek was a planet evacuated by Imperials after the Battle of Endor, along with Narth. While they were being evacuated, the Star Destroyer Gnisnal was demolished by internal explosions. This provided enormous amounts of information to the New Republic, giving them a complete copy of the Imperial Order of battle.

Jabor.title: Jabor

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Jabor.lead: Jabor was a planet where Ferus Olin worked for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Ferus sent double agent Clive Flax undercover into the local Separatist base, thus disrupting a spy ring that had taken root throughout the Mid Rim. Its subsequent destruction saved many lives.

Hewl.title: Hewl
Hewl.lead: Hewl was an astronomical object located within the Hewl system, a part of the Mid Rim's Eidoloni sector. Karap Valley was located on Hewl, and it featured fog banks that were considered to be infamous by the Rebel Alliance Lieutenant Colonel Palpatine Essex Yerac.

Hapuntep.title: Hapuntep (disambiguation)
Hapuntep.lead: Hapuntep may refer to one of the following:

Hespry.title: Hespry
Hespry.lead: Hespry was the fifth planet orbiting the star Striar in the Malastare system. Located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim, it was an ice ball.

Greeve.title: Greeve
Greeve.lead: Greeve was a farm world with heavy gravity that was located in the Grumani sector. The population of Greeve were often considered to be "yokels", and over the years they provided manpower for many different armies.

Hudalla.title: Hudalla
Hudalla.lead: Hudalla was a large red and violet gas giant found in the Hudalla system. Its planetary rings were some of the largest in the entire galaxy. Sifo-Dyas referenced Hudalla's size when joking about the ego of fellow Jedi Initiate Dooku. A type of onion ring wrapped in puffer pig bacon was named the Rings of Hudalla in the planet's honor, and the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs included the recipe in his cookbook.

Kabal.title: Kabal/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Eriadu Authority, New Republic

Kabal.lead: Kabal was an Outer Rim planet in Mayagil sector, on the Sharlissian Trade Corridor.

Kallistas.title: Kallistas
Kallistas.lead: Kallistas was a mining colony next to the Revkinn system in the Parmel sector. Its low mountains covered radioactive elements and rare gemstones. Numerous pirate bases were located on the planet. Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik spent part of his childhood, especially during the summers, on this planet.

Joralla.title: Joralla

facts.climate: Hot (tropical and equatorial zones), Cool (polar regions), Temperate (rest of the planet)
facts.terrain: Chasms, Forests, Jungles, Mountains, Plateaus, Rivers, Volcanoes, Waterfalls

Joralla.lead: Joralla was a jungle planet located in the Mid Rim's Mektrun sector. It orbited the red giant star Jaska and had an unstable climate that displayed considerable weather and seasonal changes. The planet's surface was divided between vast oceans and three main continents, whose terrain included high mountains, forests, and verdant jungles. The latter featured remarkably diverse plant life, including tequa bushes, sio trees, redspar fruits, and kewafi flowers. Various animal species also inhabited Joralla, such as the herbivorous oslets and the predatory wulkarsks.

Kheedar.title: Kheedar
Kheedar.lead: Kheedar was an Outer Rim Territories planet in the Kheedar system. It had hydrocarbon processing facilities.

Kelro.title: Kelro
Kelro.lead: Kelro was the second planet in the Lazerian system. Located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region, it was found along the trade routes known as the Harrin Trade Corridor and Kira Run. The planet orbited the yellow star Lazerian and was a desolate, searing hot planet with a rocky landscape and no moons. At some point, Kelro was explored and mapped by the inhabitants of the planet Lazerian IV, and it was subsequently considered useless.

Kelliadu.title: Kelliadu

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Lipsec Run, Nothoiin Corridor, Rimma Trade Route, Senex Trace, Yankirk Route

Kelliadu.lead: Kelliadu was a terrestrial planet in the Eriadu system, located in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Along with the rest of its star system, the planet was located on the hyperspace routes known as the Hydian Way, the Lipsec Run, the Nothoiin Corridor, the Rimma Trade Route, the Senex Trace, and the Yankirk Route.

Kalinda.title: Kalinda
Kalinda.lead: Kalinda was the primary star of the Kalinda system.

Kalgo 13.title: Kalgo 13
Kalgo 13.lead: Kalgo 13 was a planet in the Kalgo system. It was the homeworld of Gyla Petro.

K'vath 5.title: K'vath 5
K'vath 5.lead: K'vath 5 was a planet in the K'vath system, located along the Rimma Trade Route.

Jarvanam.title: Jarvanam
Jarvanam.lead: Jarvanam was a planet located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Astal sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Baradis School of Technology, a covert criminal training organization and member of the Tenloss Syndicate.

Kath II.title: Kath II

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Kath II.lead: Kath II, also known as Kath, was an ocean-covered world located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim.

Kath.title: Kath/Legends
Kath.lead: The Kath were a reptilian sentient species that shared its name with the ocean world Kath II, also known simply as Kath, of the Mid Rim's Dustig sector. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the Kath Thlan-sa served as an Alliance operative. At some point by 2 ABY, the Shatras bounty hunter Ssach'thirix, who only pursued bounties posted on individuals of reptilian species, captured Thlan-sa.

Kerkoidia.title: Kerkoidia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Kerkoidia.lead: Kerkoidia was the homeworld of the Kerkoiden species and was located in the Expansion Region.

Kaliida Shoals.title: Kaliida Shoals/Legends
Kaliida Shoals.lead: Kaliida Shoals was a celestial object in the Ryndellia system, in the Mid Rim's Ryndellian sector, near the Kaliida Nebula and the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, a battle took place close to the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center.

Jurzan.title: Jurzan
Jurzan.lead: Jurzan was a planet in the Expansion Region, on the Harrin Trade Corridor.

Kedorzha.title: Kedorzha
Kedorzha.lead: Kedorzha was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Kedorzha system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane linked it to the Hestria system.

Kalab.title: Kalab
Kalab.lead: Kalab was a planet located within the Sluis sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was known to be frequented by smugglers.

Jubalene.title: Jubalene
Jubalene.lead: Jubalene was was the capital world of the Odionate in the Grumani sector. It was a foundry world where millions of slave laborers of various species were used to build Odion's war machines.

Keryt.title: Keryt
Keryt.lead: Keryt was the first planet of the Zelos system, located in the Tyus sector of the Mid Rim. It was a barren rock world without a moon.

Jermac.title: Jermac
Jermac.lead: Jermac was a world located in the Portmoak sector of the Outer Rim. Located along the Llanic Spice Run, Jermac was a notable spice producer.

Kirdo III.title: Kirdo III/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Kirdo III.lead: Kirdo III was a planet in the Tamarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located on the Sanrafsix Corridor between Sevarcos II and Ma'ar Shaddam. It was the home world of the Kitonak race.

Kira IV.title: Kira IV
Kira IV.lead: Kira IV was the fourth planet in the Kira system.

Krann.title: Krann
Krann.lead: Krann was a planet in the Expansion Region, on the Enarc Run. It was taken over by the Galactic Empire for its nova crystals, and the native Kluuzot were enslaved. Following the Battle of Endor, the sector governor seceded and established a neutral terrority. The Kluuzot were freed, and various commercial investors moved to the planet.

Kira Prime.title: Kira Prime
Kira Prime.lead: Kira Prime was originally the name of the second planet in the Kira system. It was destroyed and became an asteroid belt.

Krizzin.title: Krizzin

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Krizzin.lead: Krizzin was a planet in the Algaran system. Remote probes had discovered the existence of underground mineral deposits on Krizzin.

Kuras I.title: Kuras I

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Kuras I.lead: Kuras I was the first planet in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. It was a hot, rocky wasteland.

Kuras II.title: Kuras II

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Kuras II.lead: Kuras II was the second planet in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. Kuras II was a dry, desert world orbited by two moons.

Kira.title: Kira
Kira.lead: Lady Kira was the wife of Modon Kira and the Queen of Onderon. She offered shelter to Leia Organa Solo during Operation Shadow Hand.

Krnay.title: Krnay
Krnay.lead: Krnay was a location in the Krnay system of the Mid Rim's Vilonis sector. The young Rith Murisson, who at one point underwent a Umgullian blob massage therapy session on the planet Umgul, hailed from Krnay. Senior Anthropologist Mammon Hoole later noted Murisson's origin in an account of her experience on Umgul that was eventually included in the book The Essential Guide to Alien Species.

Kira II.title: Kira II
Kira II.lead: Kira II was the second planet in the Kira system, originally named Kira Prime by explorers from the Old Republic.

Kreeling.title: Kreeling/Legends
Kreeling.lead: Kreeling was a planet where Moranda Savich managed to avoid capture by Hal Horn.

Kira III.title: Kira III
Kira III.lead: Kira III was the third planet in the Kira system.

Kira I.title: Kira I
Kira I.lead: Kira I was a planet in the Kira system, a part of the Expansion Region's Kira sector. It was an uninhabitable world with no apparent resources of value. Kira I was surveyed by Galactic Republic scouts visiting the Kira system years before 70 BBY. At some point following the initial survey, Kira I and two other planets of the system were destroyed by a cataclysm of unknown origin, leaving behind an asteroid field.

Korad.title: Korad

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Korad.lead: Korad was a planet in Elrood sector on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. It was covered with starship and vehicle wrecks and was, in essence, a massive salvage yard operated during the Old Republic era by a corporation called Renew which eventually went bankrupt. During the Rebellion era many refugees and scavengers inhabited the planet. It was the homeworld of Slythor, a Squib crime lord.

Lacca.title: Lacca
Lacca.lead: Lacca was the second planet orbiting the star Striar in the Malastare system. Located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim, it was a volcanic rock.

Kishpaugh.title: Kishpaugh
Kishpaugh.lead: Kishpaugh was a planet located within the Kishpaugh system of the Mid Rim.

Kyrska.title: Kyrska (disambiguation)
Kyrska.lead: Kyrska may refer to one of the following:

Knores.title: Knores
Knores.lead: Knores was a Mid Rim world located in the Senex sector that was famous for its red seas. The world also featured a deep equatorial trench, appealing cities, and violent weather. By 3637 BBY, the seismologist Fez Burba hypothesized that a civilization once existing on Knores had been rendered extinct due to shifts in Knores' crust. Millennia later, the world was ruled by the aristocratic House Viholn.

Kimm Besh.title: Kimm Besh
Kimm Besh.lead: Kimm Besh was a planet located in the Kimm Besh system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was one of a trio of dingy industrial worlds belonging to House Sreethyn.

Klytus V.title: Klytus V
Klytus V.lead: Klytus V, was a gas giant in the fifth orbital position of the Klytus system located on the edge of Wild Space in grid square H-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The planet had at least one prominent storm in its atmosphere, and its eye was crimson in color and visible from orbit. Klytus V was orbited by the space station Klytus V Station, which the Duro Interstellar Freight and Shipping company made deliveries to.

Linuri.title: Linuri
Linuri.lead: Linuri was a planet in the Doldur sector with a diverse ecosystem. Most of the planet's regions could support humanoid life.

Lazerian IV.title: Lazerian IV

facts.affiliation: Doxeti, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Kingdom of Devit

Lazerian IV.lead: Lazerian IV was a planet in the Kira sector, located in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It served as the endpoint of the Kira Run hyperlane and also sat along the Harrin Trade Corridor alongside the rest of the Lazerian system. The planet was the center of the system's civilization and was its main planet. It had an extensive history of loyalty to the Galactic Empire, and its people were extremely stubborn when it came to change.

M'haeli.title: M'haeli/Legends
M'haeli.lead: M'haeli was an agriworld in the Expansion Region ruled by a hereditary Human monarchy, despite its indigenous species being the H'drachi. Under the New Order, the planet was under the authority of Governor Grigor and Grand Moff Lynch Hauser. It was the homeworld of Ixidro Legorburu.

Lan Barell.title: Lan Barell/Legends
Lan Barell.lead: Lan Barell was a dusty, dry neutral backwater planet located on the Outer Rim of the galaxy near Breshkall. Heavy iron content in the soil gave the planet a faint blue sheen, and when combined with the red glare of its sun, gave the planet a garish and gloomy atmosphere.

Majoor.title: Majoor
Majoor.lead: Majoor was the homeworld of a native sentient species. It was located in the Expansion Region.

Loovria.title: Loovria/Legends
Loovria.lead: Loovria was a planet in the Juvex sector of the Mid Rim along the Senex-Juvex Loop known for its gladiator pits.

Lanthe.title: Lanthe
Lanthe.lead: Lanthe was a planet in the Mid Rim's Var Hagen sector. It was the original headquarters of Lanthe Artifice, but when the local Imperial Moff nationalized all corporations, Lanthe Artifice relocated to the Tapani sector.

Lazerian IX.title: Lazerian IX
Lazerian IX.lead: Lazerian IX was a planet that occupied the ninth orbital position in the Lazerian system. It was located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. The planet was a frigid, rocky world with no moons, and orbited the yellow star known as Lazerian. Lazerian IX was found along the trade routes known as the Harrin Trade Corridor and Kira Run. At some point, it was surveyed by the Lazerians of the planet Lazerian IV.

Lununmo.title: Lununmo

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Silvestri Trace/Sanctuary Pipeline

Lununmo.lead: Lununmo was the second planet orbiting the star Sullust in the Sullust system. Located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant with 34 moons.

Laramus.title: Laramus

facts.affiliation: Laramus Base Irregulars, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Laramus.lead: Laramus was the location of Laramus Base, headquarters of the Laramus Base Irregulars, as well as a rapidly-growing Rebel cell. The Visseon II led a Rebel ambush of an Imperial convoy over Laramus. The Empire later destroyed much of the planet's surface, forcing the Irregulars to leave.

Luptoom.title: Luptoom
Luptoom.lead: Luptoom was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Seswenna sector. The planet's Human population, known as Luptoomians, was known for its unusual style of clothing. During the Separatist Crisis, the Luptoomian Nar Hida opened a fashion store on the planet Coruscant.

Manari.title: Manari
Manari.lead: Manari was a planet in the Manari system of the Brevost sector, one of the Trailing Sectors in the Expansion Region. During the time of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Manari was ruled by tradition-bound leaders who had a very delicate political etiquette. In 19.5 BBY, during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Republic forces fought in the Battle of Manari against an anti-Republic force.

Luxiar 7.title: Luxiar 7
Luxiar 7.lead: Luxiar 7 was a planet located within the Luxiar system of the Outer Rim Territories. There, R'Ytha Myr dated a person called "Ace", most probably Ace Azzameen himself.

Lesser Galam.title: Lesser Galam
Lesser Galam.lead: Lesser Galam was a moonless planet, the first from the star Lan of the Lan system. By the time of the Galactic Empire, underground mining colonies had been constructed on the planet. The export of ore from mines on Lesser Galam and the other inner planets was the system's only real source of income during that time.

Maro Della.title: Maro Della
Maro Della.lead: Maro Della was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Maro Della system of the Mektrun sector, a part of the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. At some point by the date 38:4:1:02, the individual Hyannis was involved in a firefight on Maro Della. During the skirmish, Hyannis prepared to fire a Model MGL-1 micro-grenade launcher. The magnetic rings that propelled the weapon's projectiles, however, had degraded due to lack of maintenance and failed.

Lanjer.title: Lanjer/Legends
Lanjer.lead: Lanjer was a remote planet that defied Emperor Palpatine shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Like the other worlds that refused to cooperate, Lanjer suffered an unspecified devastation as a result.

Maill.title: Maill
Maill.lead: Maill was a planet located within the Maill system of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was well-known for having produced one of the rarest coins in the galaxy; the world's King had commissioned the coin in honor of his wife. The coin was minted from a special alloy to have the color of a flaming sunset—to match the color of the lady's hair. The alloy ended up destroying the minting machines and only a few hundred coins were produced.

Lan Fellov.title: Lan Fellov
Lan Fellov.lead: Lan Fellov was a terrestrial planet orbiting the star Lan in the Lan system. It was situated within the Hook Nebula of the Outer Rim Territories and had one moon. As with all worlds of the Lan system, except for the planet Lan Barell, Lan Fellov was incapable of supporting life and featured a barren, rocky surface.

Lan Tundi.title: Lan Tundi
Lan Tundi.lead: Lan Tundi was an ore-rich planet in the Outer Rim's Lan system. Though its barren surface could not support life, underground mining colonies had been constructed on the planet by the time of the Galactic Empire. During that time, the export of ore from mines on Lan Tundi and the other inner planets was the system's only real source of income.

Loposi Three.title: Loposi Three
Loposi Three.lead: Loposi Three was a planet in the Loposi system of the Mid Rim's Dustig sector. Loposi Three's moon possessed an artificial atmosphere of nutrient-rich gases that were derived from liquid kolto, a medicinal plant. The Loposi system was later a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Monor II.title: Monor II
Monor II.lead: Monor II, also called Kline Colony, was the Sunesi homeworld. It was ruled by a monarchy of priest-princes. The tenth, Agapos the Tenth, ascended in 24 ABY. This planet was where the mysterious Nom Anor infected various New Republic diplomats and Mara Jade Skywalker with coomb spores, killing many of them.

Mima.title: Mima II
Mima.lead: Mima II, also referred to as Mima, was a tropical planet located in the Mid Rim's D'Aelgoth sector. The gravitational influence of Lar, the planet's star, caused the tectonic plates on Mima II to be constantly moving across its surface in various directions, leading to the active creation of new landforms, such as mountains and seas. The accompanying release of chemical elements vital to the development of life resulted in the planet being abundant with plant and animal species, including the sentient Bilars.

Mima II.title: Mima II
Mima II.lead: Mima II, also referred to as Mima, was a tropical planet located in the Mid Rim's D'Aelgoth sector. The gravitational influence of Lar, the planet's star, caused the tectonic plates on Mima II to be constantly moving across its surface in various directions, leading to the active creation of new landforms, such as mountains and seas. The accompanying release of chemical elements vital to the development of life resulted in the planet being abundant with plant and animal species, including the sentient Bilars.

Naalol.title: Naalol/Legends
Naalol.lead: Naalol was a sparsely-inhabited backwater planet, third in the Naalol system, with a small Imperial garrison. It was the Oquan headquarters. It had high peaks, winding ridges, with small towns in the mountains, and larger cities in the plains below.

Nantama.title: Nantama
Nantama.lead: Nantama was a wealthy resort world, controlled by House Elegin, renowned for the natural beauty of its fields. The Third Nantama Synod was held there.

Msst.title: Msst
Msst.lead: Msst was a Mid Rim planet, and the homeworld of Brakiss. It was a small planet in the Msst system, which had an Imperial stronghold. The Empire had theoretically abandoned it after the Invasion of Bakura. Luke Skywalker came to Msst in search of Brakiss, where, shortly after landing, he was attacked by a group of mistmakers.

Morcanth.title: Morcanth
Morcanth.lead: Morcanth was an Unknown Regions planet the galactic neighborhood of which was the subject of a centuries-long war between three spacefaring alien species. At one point, the corrupted Jedi Winslau Da'k imprisoned his former Jedi Master at a fortress on Morcanth, where Da'k resided in wealth and comfort. After the Jedi Master telepathically sought out help from a group of agents of the Rebel Alliance, the rebels ultimately orchestrated an assault on Da'k's fortress and successfully rescued the Jedi.

Mumunubb.title: Mumunubb

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Silvestri Trace/Sanctuary Pipeline

Mumunubb.lead: Mumunubb was an planet which orbited the star Sullust in the Sullust system. Located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it shared the fifth orbit with Munumubb.

Munumubb.title: Munumubb

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Silvestri Trace/Sanctuary Pipeline

Munumubb.lead: Munumubb was an planet which orbited the star Sullust in the Sullust system. Located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it shared the fifth orbit with Mumunubb.

Muntiadu.title: Muntiadu

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Lipsec Run, Nothoiin Corridor, Rimma Trade Route, Senex Trace, Yankirk Route

Muntiadu.lead: Muntiadu was a terrestrial planet in the Eriadu system, located in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet and its star system were located on the hyperspace routes known as Hydian Way, Lipsec Run, Nothoiin Corridor, Rimma Trade Route, Senex Trace, and Yankirk Route. Muntiadu occupied the first orbital position around the star Eriadu and had no moons. It featured a molten rock surface and a hot climate.

Meris I.title: Meris I

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Meris I.lead: Meris I was the first planet in the Meris system of the Elrood sector. It was an uninhabitable ball of searing rock.

Meris V.title: Meris V

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Meris V.lead: Meris V was a chilly, barren wasteland in the Meris system of the Elrood sector. The landscape of Meris V was mostly composed of rocky wastes, and was orbited by a single moon. Meris V remained unexplored, and there remained many undiscovered ore deposits on the rocky world.

Mordis VI.title: Mordis VI
Mordis VI.lead: Mordis VI was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Mordis system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. Acid storms were a weather phenomenon that occurred on Mordis VI's surface. The bounty hunter Zam Wesell once claimed that, due to it being designed for operation on wasteland worlds with thin, low-oxygen, or corrosive atmospheres, her stolen Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder could withstand the effects of an acid storm on Mordis VI.

Moth.title: Moth/Legends
Moth.lead: A moth was a species of winged insect. There were many kinds of moths.

Medth.title: Medth

facts.region: Mid Rim, Trailing Sectors, Western Reaches

Medth.lead: Medth was a planet. The privateer Urias Xhaxin once raided the planet's region in his ship, the Free Lance.

Medepiest.title: Medepiest (disambiguation)
Medepiest.lead: Medepiest may refer to one of the following:

Melambo.title: Melambo
Melambo.lead: Melambo was the seventh planet orbiting the star Striar in the Malastare system. Located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim, it was a gas giant.

Mirnic.title: Mirnic (disambiguation)
Mirnic.lead: Mirnic could refer to one of the following:

Matacorn.title: Matacorn
Matacorn.lead: Matacorn was a terrestrial world located in the Matacorn system, a part of the Mid Rim's Lambda sector. A nondescript trade world, it was the homeworld of the Human Hurst Romodi. Matacorn also shared its name with the Matacorn campaign, a part of the Galactic Civil War.

Momansi Belt.title: Momansi Belt
Momansi Belt.lead: Momansi Belt was an asteroid belt in the Expansion Region.

Gozgo.title: Moons of Gozgo
Gozgo.lead: The moons of Gozgo were a group of at least two moons located in the galaxy. The moons were referenced in a curse used by Cikatro Vizago, Kemlin and Orka.

Omdrid.title: Omdrid
Omdrid.lead: Omdrid was a planet that occupied the seventh orbit around the star Beheboth. It was the outermost celestial body in the Beheboth system, a star system that was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors in the Outer Rim Territories. Like its inner neighbor Derenath, Omdrid was classified as an ice planet and had no moons.

Ninzam VI.title: Ninzam VI
Ninzam VI.lead: Ninzam VI was a planet in the Ninzam system. The Draag species was native to the planet.

Oolidi.title: Oolidi
Oolidi.lead: Oolidi was a planet that was located in the Expansion Region. Oolidi was also the Oolid homeworld.

Old Mankoo.title: Old Mankoo
Old Mankoo.lead: Old Mankoo was a planet located in the Old Mankoo system, a part of the Quess sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. The planet was impoverished, and by 23 BBY, the royal family of Old Mankoo had been overthrown.

Nuralee.title: Nuralee
Nuralee.lead: Nuralee was a Mid Rim world in the Tyus sector. It had an economic breakdown shortly before the Clone Wars. It was represented in the Galactic Senate by Bog Divinian, a wealthy landowner with ties to the Commerce Guild.

Obica.title: Obica
Obica.lead: Obica was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Grumani sector. The holy world of the Spumani religion, it was the site of regular pilgrimages and even more frequent wars. At one point, access to the planet was controlled by the Spumani-affiliated Scholastic Guardians; centuries later, during the New Sith Wars, the Galactic Republic was no longer aware of the state of affairs on Obica.

Nigel III.title: Nigel III
Nigel III.lead: Nigel III was a planet in the Expansion Region situated along the Enarc Run hyperspace route. It had an Imperial presence during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The world's port authority seized the Kazellis-class light freighter Longrunner after its pilot, Duan Zorn, was arrested for stealing the starship and failing to pay docking fees.

Nulan VI.title: Nulan VI

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Nulan VI.lead: Nulan VI was a celestial body situated in the Nulan system of the Hook Nebula, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of a capital that, at some point by the time shortly after the Battle of Yavin, rebelled against the Galactic Empire and allied itself with the Rebel Alliance.

Narth.title: Narth
Narth.lead: Narth was a planet evacuated along with Ihopek after the Battle of Endor by the Galactic Empire. The Star Destroyer Gnisnal was crippled by internal explosions and had to be scuttled. The wreckage later gave the New Republic the complete copy of the Imperial Order of battle.

Notak.title: Notak
Notak.lead: Notak was an Imperial stronghold throughout the Galactic Civil War. The planet fell eight months after the Battle of Endor.

Nellac Kram.title: Nellac Kram
Nellac Kram.lead: Nellac Kram was planet in Outer Rim Territories in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector. The New Republic freighter Nartissteu was based out of Nellac Kram.

Nigel VI.title: Nigel VI
Nigel VI.lead: Nigel VI was a planet in the Nigel system of the Expansion Region, and was the site of a little-known Human colony. The planet was somewhat cold, with glaciers, plains, and large polar ice caps among the dominant topographical features. Nigel VI was governed by a local republic that chiefly focused on combating crime. The planet did not establish trade connections with the rest of the galaxy until around the time of the New Republic.

Nomlis III.title: Nomlis III
Nomlis III.lead: Nomlis III was a planet in the Kurdin system where the Bretie Facility, a production center for the TIE Experimental Project, orbited. Nothing else is known about the planet, other than the fact that it was the site of the battle in which Rebel Alliance pilots, one of them being Ace Azzameen, raided and destroyed the Bretie Facility in their quest to disrupt the TIE Experimental Project being carried out by the Galactic Empire.

Nilash III.title: Nilash III

facts.affiliation: Daimanate, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Nilash III.lead: Nilash III, also called simply Nilash, was the third planet in the Nilash system, located close to the baradium-rich planet Chelloa. It was home to a tree-dwelling, telepathic native species and a known source of anthracite.
