During the New Sith Wars the jungle-covered planet housed a Daimanite munitions plant while, under the rule of the Galactic Empire, the Nilash Imperial Impound Facility was established in an orbit around the world. It was on this world that the later-famous smuggling freighter the Millennium Falcon, at the time known as the Second Chance, first came into Rebel possession.

Ness.title: Ness
Ness.lead: Ness was a terrestrial planet in the Dagobah system of the Sluis sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Along with the rest of the star system, the planet lay on the hyperlane known as the Rimma Trade Route, and it occupied the first orbital position around the star Darlo. Its surface consisted of molten rock, and the planet featured a searing hot environment.

Nuvar.title: Nuvar
Nuvar.lead: Nuvar was a jungle planet in the Mid Rim near the modern Hydian Way. In 3701 BBY, Freia Kallea's scoutship Hope crash-landed on uncharted Nuvar after it was crippled by the Neimoidians Thoax and Farge Osaax, leaving her stranded for six standard years. Banu Hydia located her on the planet and found her in a wild state.

Oosti.title: Oosti
Oosti.lead: Oosti was the sixth planet orbiting the star Shadda in the Shadda-Bi-Boran system. Located in the Toblain sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was an ice world.

Oranessan.title: Oranessan
Oranessan.lead: Oranessan was a planet that was located in the Grumani sector.

Old Barag.title: Old Barag/Legends
Old Barag.lead: Old Barag was a planet located in the Old Barag system of the Epsi Collective, within the galaxy's Expansion Region. In the year 11,591 BBY, the Baragwin homeworld was attacked by the Pius Dea Republic during the Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade. By the publication of The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life first draft in 0 BBY, Old Barag had long since been forgotten, even by the Baragwin themselves.

Praesitlyn.title: Praesitlyn/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Praesitlyn.lead: Praesitlyn was a planet in the Sluis sector of the Outer Rim. It was the location of the Intergalactic Communications Center, a major HoloNet hub in the galaxy. The Communications Center became a strategic asset during the Clone Wars, leading to the fierce Battle of Praesitlyn.

Phelarion.title: Phelarion/Legends
Phelarion.lead: Phelarion was a planet located in the Seswenna sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. In was the homeworld of the wealthy Motti family, which included figures prominent in the Galactic Empire such as Lady Thalassa Tarkin, wife of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, and Conan Antonio Motti, Admiral of the Imperial Navy. The Motti family were wealthy citizens in the megonite moss mining business, established in the centuries prior to 60 BBY, using slave labor.

Ord Ibanna.title: Ord Ibanna
Ord Ibanna.lead: Ord Ibanna was a gas giant in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet once housed a Tibanna mining colony, which was abandoned sometime prior to the Invasion of Naboo as well as being the site of an intense naval engagement between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War.

Plagen.title: Plagen
Plagen.lead: Plagen was a planet in the Expansion Region, on the Enarc Run, with high plateaus covered in lakes and grasslands of lush yellow flora; its lowlands were dry plains.

Ord Grovner.title: Ord Grovner
Ord Grovner.lead: Ord Grovner was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories near Courkrus. Originally an Ordnance/Regional Depot, the planet served as a staging area for the Imperial task force, led by Admiral Freeda, which wiped out the Eyttyrmin Batiiv pirates.

Ord Dorlass.title: Ord Dorlass
Ord Dorlass.lead: Ord Dorlass was a Mid Rim world located in the Iskin sector. Serving as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, around 3643 BBY it was affected by an epidemic of a dangerous disease. During the Galactic Civil War it served as a stopping point in the popular interstellar race known as the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade.

Ord Simres.title: Ord Simres
Ord Simres.lead: Ord Simres was a planet in the Outer Rim's Brema sector.

Ord Zeuol.title: Ord Zeuol
Ord Zeuol.lead: Ord Zeuol was a planet in the Ord Zeuol system, a part of the Vilonis sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. The planet served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite being located outside the Republic's borders.

Orryxia.title: Orryxia
Orryxia.lead: Orryxia was a planet in the Orryxia system, in the Outer Rim Territories near Eriadu. It was home to the Orryxians, a sentient species sometimes given the derogatory nickname "Cats." It was also home to the orycat, a small woodland predator. Wilek Nereus, the Imperial Governor of Bakura, visited the planet and obtained a dental specimen of the orycat but was unable to complete a comprehensive survey of the creature's environment due to adverse conditions.

Parein II.title: Parein II/Legends
Parein II.lead: Parein II was a planet in the Sarin sector.

Orto Plutonia.title: Orto Plutonia/Legends
Orto Plutonia.lead: Orto Plutonia was a desolate icy planet in the Pantora system, home to the native Talz and a number of narglatches. It was considered a protectorate of the orbiting moon Pantora until the Clone Wars, when the Talz inhabitants were granted political supremacy by the Pantoran Assembly following a brief conflict with, Galactic Republic forces.

Phaegon III.title: Phaegon III
Phaegon III.lead: The planet Phaegon III was in the Phaegon system in the Grumani sector. Its largest moon was the main source of Lignan ore. In 5000 BBY, Sith Lord Naga Sadow ordered that the Lignan be mined, and Saes Rrogon and Yaru Korsin led a Sith force to the moon shortly before the Battle of Kirrek.

Paqwepor.title: Paqwepor
Paqwepor.lead: Paqwepor was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Mid Rim.

Paqwepor Major.title: Paqwepor Major

facts.affiliation: Paqwe family, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, New Republic, Galactic Alliance

Paqwepor Major.lead: Paqwepor Major, also known as Paqwepor, or Paqwepori, was a planet in the Mid Rim off the Corellian Run. It was within the region of Paqwepori. Paqwepor Major was the Paqwe homeworld and it was ruled by the Paqwe family. During the Clone Wars, Paqwepor Major was located within Separatist space.

Pieldi.title: Pieldi
Pieldi.lead: Pieldi was a celestial body located in the Pieldi system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It lay on the hyperlane known as the Senex-Juvex Loop, which connected it to the Pirralor and Velga systems, while the Agarix Trade Route linked it to the Dramassia system. Pieldi was a thriving spaceport that, like all the worlds of the Senex-Juvex, was under the control of the region's aristocratic Ancient Houses.

Parwa.title: Parwa/Legends
Parwa.lead: Parwa was a world that was located in the Seswenna sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. The Parwan bounty hunter Derrown originated on Parwa.

Ord Hout.title: Ord Hout
Ord Hout.lead: Ord Hout was a world located in the Ord Hout system. It was situated in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Ord Hout served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY.

Ord Gallapraxis.title: Ord Gallapraxis
Ord Gallapraxis.lead: Ord Gallapraxis was an Ordnance/Regional Depot in the Expansion Region. It was colonized by the Galactic Republic sometime before the Pius Dea Era.

Ord Zynthar.title: Ord Zynthar
Ord Zynthar.lead: Ord Zynthar was a world located in the Ord Zynthar system. It was situated in the Lambda sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim.

Pax.title: Pax
Pax.lead: Pax was a world located in the Pax system of the Kira sector, a part of the Expansion Region and the Trailing Sectors in grid square N-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The hyperspace route known as the Hydian Way linked it to the Chardaan and ZeHeth systems while the Enarc Run connected it to Kira and Vondarc systems.

Rintonne.title: Rintonne/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Darth Krayt's Sith Empire

Rintonne.lead: Rintonne was a Mid Rim planet in the Lambda sector. A member of the Galactic Republic, Rintonne was the homeworld of Rasit Brun, the sectorial Senator representing Lambda in 32 BBY.

Reuss VIII.title: Reuss VIII/Legends
Reuss VIII.lead: Reuss VIII was a planet in Portmoak sector. It was an agriworld of the Galactic Republic, but under the Empire became a polluted industrial world. Torel Vorne was the most powerful crime lord on the planet.

Rimma 13.title: Rimma 13

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Lipsec Run, Nothoiin Corridor, Rimma Trade Route, Senex Trace, Yankirk Route

Rimma 13.lead: Rimma 13 was a hyperspace exit point located within the Eriadu system, a part of Seswenna sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It shared its name with the Rimma Trade Route.

Qiaxx.title: Qiaxx
Qiaxx.lead: Qiaxx was a planet in the Cor'ric sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Rior.title: Rior/Legends
Rior.lead: Rior was an astronomical object located in the Rior system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tamarin sector. The Riorian murderer Stalnus, who was born in 68 BBY, hailed from Rior.

Rhamsis Callo.title: Rhamsis Callo
Rhamsis Callo.lead: Rhamsis Callo was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Danjar sector. It was the homeworld of the Force-sensitive and militaristic Schenor species, which allowed the Galactic Empire to construct a base on the planet despite remaining neutral in the Galactic Civil War. During that conflict, a team of Rebel Alliance agents delivered a young survivor of an Imperial massacre of a Schenor colony to Rhamsis Callo. When the Schenor noble B'karitz learned about the massacre, he led an insurrection that attempted to drive the Imperial forces off Rhamsis Callo.

Qexis.title: Qexis
Qexis.lead: Qexis was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a high-security research planet with only one spaceport. Few knew it existed.

Rela.title: Rela
Rela.lead: Rela was the seventh planet in the Obas system. It was orbited by 8 moons.

Ramodi.title: Ramodi
Ramodi.lead: Ramodi was a Galactic Alliance planet with a baradium smuggling ring, rimward of Borao.

Riome.title: Riome

facts.terrain: Ice-covered, Rolling foothills and grassland, Craggy ice islands

Riome.lead: Riome was a little, frigid world located in the Dorvalla system of the Outer Rim Territories. The Toom clan set up a hideout here after sabotaging Lommite Limited and InterGalactic Ore's freighters in 33 BBY, but Darth Maul was able to anonymously lead Patch Bruit and other LL workers to Riome, where they gunned down each and every Toom member on the planet. Eventually, Darth Maul was waiting in the shadows, and himself took down the remaining combatants.

Revkinn V.title: Revkinn V
Revkinn V.lead: Revkinn V was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories known for its megalopolises.

Rezi-9.title: Rezi-9
Rezi-9.lead: Rezi-9 was an astronomical object located within the Rezi system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bajic sector. Wesau T'orrin, an individual participating in the blaster skill event of the Galactic Games on the Mid Rim planet Euceron in 27 BBY, was from Rezi-9.

Regulgo.title: Regulgo
Regulgo.lead: Regulgo was a planet located in the Regulgo system, a part of the Ryndellian sector within the Mid Rim and Trailing Sectors regions. Months after Han Solo departed Kamar in approximately 2 BBY, Kamarians tracked him down on Regulgo. While there, the Kamarians attacked Solo and took him captive; however, Solo eventually escaped.

Ragith III.title: Ragith III
Ragith III.lead: Ragith III was a minor world in the Expansion Region, that had been settled by Humans for several generations by the time of the Dissolution of the Imperial Senate. The Ragithian Human inhabitants were descendant from colonists genetically bred and selected to adapt to the high gravity of the planet. Rodo the bouncer came from Ragith III.

Reuss VI.title: Reuss VI
Reuss VI.lead: Reuss VI was the sixth planet in the Reuss system.

Presteen.title: Presteen
Presteen.lead: Presteen was a trade world located in the Presteen system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Caltinia and Veron systems. Presteen was under the control of the lesser nobles of House Araba, based on the nearby planet of Cyimarra.

Qi Lozar.title: Qi Lozar
Qi Lozar.lead: Qi Lozar was a desert world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It served as a haven for hermits, refugees and other individuals who were trying to escape their pasts.

Raamen.title: Raamen
Raamen.lead: Raamen was a planet located in the Expansion Region.

Prine.title: Prine
Prine.lead: Prine was a mostly-uninhabited desert-covered planet situated on the way between Telerath and Vondarc. It also possessed grasslands where agriculture was possible.

Reuss.title: Reuss VIII
Reuss.lead: Reuss VIII was a planet in the Reuss system in the Portmoak sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located along the Llanic Spice Run hyperspace route. It was a major agriworld during the rule of the Galactic Republic, but the Galactic Empire proceeded to overharvest its fields and polluted the atmosphere with industrial factories, destroying the world's natural habitats.

Ropagi II.title: Ropagi II
Ropagi II.lead: Ropagi II was a planet in Kira sector, on the Enarc Run. It was an endpoint of the Kira Run and was home to two native species.

Sanbra.title: Sanbra

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Sanbra.lead: Sanbra was the location of the University of Sanbra. It also the location of the Shoapy Hostel.

Ruten.title: Ruten
Ruten.lead: Ruten was a planet in the Cerenia system of the Expansion Region. The New Republic liberated the planet from Imperial Governor Bursthed. The planet hosted the Ruten Pet Show.

Roldalna.title: Roldalna
Roldalna.lead: Roldalna was a celestial body located in the Expansion Region's Kira sector. Shortly after the formation of the New Republic, it was the site of a cantina.

Rue.title: Rue
Rue.lead: Rue was the sixth planet in the Gacerian system. It was a frigid rock planet with no moons.

Santarine.title: Santarine
Santarine.lead: Santarine was a planet that was located within the Hook Nebula, along the Outer Rim of the galaxy.

Rugosa.title: Rugosa/Legends
Rugosa.lead: Rugosa, also known as the coral moon, was a temperate moon in the Sanbra sector. It was one of the worlds that made up the Infinite Empire, a galactic power led by the Rakatan species in approximately 30,000 BBY. The moon was later discovered by Toydarian scouts working near the Balmorra Run, and because of its attractive climate and warm oceans, it became a Toydarian vacation spot that they kept secret from their Hutt masters.

Ryndellia.title: Ryndellia/Legends
Ryndellia.lead: Ryndellia was a celestial object in the Ryndellia system, in the Mid Rim's Ryndellian sector, close to the Outer Rim Territories. It was also close to the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center and the planet Naboo.

Saba Reese.title: Saba Reese
Saba Reese.lead: Saba Reese was the first planet orbiting the star Striar in the Malastare system. Located in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim, it was a searing rock.

Sarrassia.title: Sarrassia/Legends
Sarrassia.lead: Sarrassia was a world in the Sarrassia system, in the Grumani sector. It was a known source of Sarrassian iron.

Roccus.title: Roccus
Roccus.lead: Roccus was a planet in the Roccus system that was home to one of Twin Suns Transport Services' service platforms.

Samhar.title: Samhar
Samhar.lead: Samhar was a forest-covered world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by the Samhari, a Near-Human species.

Sarrelon I.title: Sarrelon I
Sarrelon I.lead: Sarrelon I was the first planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. The planet had two moons.

Sarrelon II.title: Sarrelon II
Sarrelon II.lead: Sarrelon II was the second planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. A desolate, searing ball of rock, Sarrelon II was orbited by three moons.

Sarrelon III.title: Sarrelon III
Sarrelon III.lead: Sarrelon III was the third planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. It was a gas giant with five moons.

Sarrelon IV.title: Sarrelon IV
Sarrelon IV.lead: Sarrelon IV was the fourth planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. It was a gas giant with eight moons.

Sarrelon V.title: Sarrelon V
Sarrelon V.lead: Sarrelon V was the fifth planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. It as a gas giant with twelve moons.

Sarranket.title: Sarranket
Sarranket.lead: Sarranket was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Sarranket system, a part of the Brevost sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.

Sarkhai.title: Sarkhai/Legends
Sarkhai.lead: Sarkhai was a Mid Rim planet covered with forests where Force-sensitives were uncommon. It belonged to the Galactic Republic. Senator Tobas Grell and his daughter Nadia were native to Sarkhai. Around the time of the Cold War, Sarkhai was ruled by the King Sethun and his wife, Queen Nyscha. The planet was one of the members of a secessionist militant group called the Rift Alliance. Although unlike most members, Sarkhai only joined out of curiosity and had no particular reason to secede from the Republic.

Rymm.title: Rymm
Rymm.lead: Rymm was the third planet of the Zelos system, located in the Tyus sector of the Mid Rim. It was a mountainous and volcanic world with one moon.

Shadda-Bi-Boran.title: Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends
Shadda-Bi-Boran.lead: Shadda-Bi-Boran was an Outer Rim planet inhabited by a sentient species of the same name. It had three moons and contained plains and swamps. Shadda-Bi-Boran orbited the sun Shadda, which had reached its white dwarf phase by the decline of the Galactic Republic. The resulting implosion threatened the Shadda-Bi-Borans, who had a purifying enzyme only activated by Shadda's sunlight.

Seswenna.title: Seswenna/Legends
Seswenna.lead: Seswenna was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Seswenna sector. By 3699 BBY, Seswenna lay on what would eventually become the Hydian Way super-hyperroute. However, the Hydian Way had shifted by 1004 BBY to go through the Eriadu system instead. During the late period of the Galactic Republic's rule, Seswenna served as the sector capital, but that status would similarly pass to the planet Eriadu over time.

Sayblohn.title: Sayblohn
Sayblohn.lead: Sayblohn was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Quess sector. It was occupied by the Galactic Empire, and a group of pirates had a hidden base in the planet's badlands. During the Galactic Civil War, a Rebel Alliance team of operatives traveled to Sayblohn in order to retrieve a stolen art object. After several run-ins with the local pirates, the team was ultimately successful in its mission.

Sevarcos II.title: Sevarcos II

facts.terrain: Mountains, Plains, Deserts, Subterranean tunnels and water networks
facts.population: 1 million (excluding mining population and Imperial personnel)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Sevarcos II.lead: Sevarcos II was the only inhabitable planet in the Sevarcos system. Sevarcos was the only source for the spice variants carsunum and andris, which were its only export. In 52 BBY, Jedi Master Dooku negotiated the Sevarcos Dispute, which would have great consequences for the history of the galaxy, and ultimately for the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Seltos.title: Seltos
Seltos.lead: Seltos was a planet in the Mid Rim. Its Sommin City was home to the largest Tarro remnant. Its primary industries included agriculture, lumber production, and mining of valuable ores. Visitors to Seltos' nature preserves provided a small boost to the economy as well. Natives of Seltos were considered congenial and pleasant.

Serphidi.title: Serphidi/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Serphidi.lead: Serphidi was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Sanbra sector. The fourth planet in the Belial system, Serphidi was blanketed in vine-draped forests that contained dangerous plant life—the planet was also home to the Serps, a reptilian sentient species that used giant lizards as mounts and who built a thriving, high-tech society before tearing it apart with generations of violence. Eventually, the Serps united under one King, rebuilding their society through banning technology and sublimating their violent urges in yearly jousting competitions.

Seylott.title: Seylott/Legends
Seylott.lead: Seylott was the homeworld of the Seylott species. It was covered in dense forests and home to the Disciples of Shaa.

Serat.title: Serat
Serat.lead: Serat was the Seratian homeworld. The aggressive nocturnal Tymps were native to Serat, and considered pests.

Sedesia.title: Sedesia
Sedesia.lead: Sedesia was a high-gravity Mid Rim world with harsh terrain and rough weather.

Serrata.title: Serrata

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Serrata.lead: Serrata was the eighth planet in the Derilyn system. It was a gas giant and had 5 moons. Serrata was a near-star, its mass falling just below the necessary level to make the transition. In the sky of Derilyn, Serrata was a reddish disk as wide as the length of a man's index finger.

Sevarcos.title: Sevarcos

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Occlusion Zone, Trailing Sectors

Sevarcos.lead: Sevarcos was a planet in the Sevarcos system of the Outer Rim Territories that was the site of a battle in 4 ABY in the months after the Battle of Endor. During the battle, the New Republic successfully liberated at least one spice mine that had been operating on slave labor under the control of the Empire. The area of the spice mine was dry, dusty, and surrounded by canyons, and at least one of the slavemasters was Zygerrian.

Sharlissia.title: Sharlissia system

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Trailing Sectors, Occlusion Zone

Sharlissia.lead: The Sharlissia system was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 228 BBY, it was enveloped by the Occlusion Zone territory of the Nihil marauders, the interior of which did not have access to hyperspace travel to and from the rest of the Galactic Republic's territory.

Schada.title: Schada
Schada.lead: Schada was a scorched rock and the first planet in the Mustafar system.

Shadda-Ul-Haru.title: Shadda-Ul-Haru
Shadda-Ul-Haru.lead: Shadda-Ul-Haru was the fourth planet orbiting the star Shadda in the Shadda-Bi-Boran system. Located in the Toblain sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Shadda-Ul-Morn.title: Shadda-Ul-Morn
Shadda-Ul-Morn.lead: Shadda-Ul-Morn was the fifth planet orbiting the star Shadda in the Shadda-Bi-Boran system. Located in the Toblain sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Scelepas.title: Scelepas
Scelepas.lead: Scelepas was a world that was located in the Tanta Aurek system, in the Grumani sector. Between 3701 BBY and 3699 BBY the Hydian Way was charted through the planet as part of the Seswenna Expansion. Before or during the Republic Dark Age, Scelepas was a motley trade world dominated by merchants from the nearby planet Cmaoli Di. However, by the time of the Second Charge Matrica, the world had descended into grinding poverty.

Sarrelon VI.title: Sarrelon VI
Sarrelon VI.lead: Sarrelon VI was the sixth planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. It was a frozen ball of rock with two moons.

Seltaya Minor.title: Seltaya Minor
Seltaya Minor.lead: Seltaya Minor, also known as Ropagi III, was a planet in the Kira sector of the Expansion Region.

Shafr.title: Shafr (disambiguation)
Shafr.lead: Shafr may refer to one of the following:

Shogun.title: Shogun
Shogun.lead: Shogun was an alias used by a Jedi of the Jedi clans who fought in the Sith rebellion. Near the end of the war, they experienced a vision of a god known as the Father, who told them to visit the Temple of Elujoji on the planet Sukalan. Years later, Shogun encountered the former Sith known as the Ronin bathing in a secret hot spring. The two shared sake and spoke of their experiences in the war and Shogun's ongoing search for the Temple of Elujoji. Before the two parted ways, the Ronin asked if Shogun had forgotten to kill him.

Sullust.title: Sullust/Legends

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Silvestri Trace/Sanctuary Pipeline
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic …

Sullust.lead: Sullust was the primary planet of the Sullust system, located in the Outer Rim Territories at the conjuncture of the Rimma Trade Route and the Silvestri Trace. It was the homeworld of the Sullustans.

Spuma.title: Spuma
Spuma.lead: Spuma was a medium sized planet in the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim. It had a number of prairies, mountains, and jungles located along its surface.

Sperin.title: Sperin

facts.affiliation: Natori Association (part of the Tenloss Syndicate)

Sperin.lead: Sperin was a planet in the Bajic sector of the Outer Rim Territories, near the Vergesso Asteroids.

Spice Terminus.title: Spice Terminus/Legends
Spice Terminus.lead: Spice Terminus was a space station in Parmic sector, at the end of the Llanic Spice Run.

Stend IV.title: Stend IV
Stend IV.lead: Stend IV was an Outer Rim planet that lay in the Juris sector. Located on the Five Veils Route hyperlane, it was a tropical world with both jungles and oceans on the surface. The Gran inhabitants of the planet Malastare settled Stend IV decades before the Galactic Civil War in an attempt to locate new sources of energy.

Stend VI.title: Stend VI
Stend VI.lead: Stend VI was an Outer Rim planet located within the Stend system of the Juris sector. Lying on the Five Veils Route hyperlane, it was a terrestrial world with a temperate climate and a terrain dominated by mountains, plains, and urban areas. Stend VI's mostly Human population was governed democratically, although the planet also served as a manufacturing site for the Galactic Empire.

Sileron.title: Sileron
Sileron.lead: Sileron was the Derkolo homeworld in the Mektrun Cluster; it was the first planet in the Veron Minor system. It was very hostile and tourists were warned not to visit the planet.

Shownar.title: Shownar/Legends

facts.government: Private ownership with organized crime leanings

Shownar.lead: Shownar was a paradise planet near the Torch Nebula. At night, the planet was illuminated by the nebula. Wind blowing through the vertag crystals created the Shownar Lullaby. It was an Imperial planet, though de facto ruled by the crime lord Oro Freatt.

Sululluub.title: Sululluub

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Silvestri Trace/Sanctuary Pipeline

Sululluub.lead: Sululluub was an asteroid field which orbited the star Sullust in the Sullust system. It was located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Sullumun.title: Sullumun

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Silvestri Trace/Sanctuary Pipeline

Sullumun.lead: Sullumun was the first planet orbiting the star Sullust in the Sullust system. Located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant with eighteen moons.

Suarbi 7.title: Suarbi 7
Suarbi 7.lead: Suarbi 7 was a gas giant within the Suarbi system in the Quence sector surrounded by an asteroid ring and at least 13 moons, including Susevfi.

Sinded.title: Sinded
Sinded.lead: Sinded was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Sinded system of the D'Aelgoth sector, a part of the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. By 7 ABY, New Republic General Crix Masst was present on Sinded. While there, the assassin Morteos wired a bomb into the repulsorlift generator of Masst's personal speeder, which resulted in the death of the general. When Morteos attempted to escape Sinded aboard his modified freighter, Y-wing starfighters on patrol opened fire, nearly shooting the assassin's vessel down. Morteos was ultimately able to escape, however.

Skustell.title: Skustell/Legends
Skustell.lead: Skustell was an humid planet in the Skustell Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Ongree, a bipedal, humpbacked, amphibious sentient species. Even after Skustell became part of galactic society, Ongree were not widely seen away from their homeworld.

Shumari.title: Shumari
Shumari.lead: Shumari was a planet in the Parmel sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Tusken Raider KkH'Oar'Rrhr was rumored to have traveled to this planet to confront the Demon Outlander who wiped out his village, otherwise known as Darth Vader.

Sika.title: Sika
Sika.lead: Sika was a planet in the Expansion Region that was invaded by opportunistic Chekut forces during the Second Galactic Civil War. It was home to the Sikan.

Speco.title: Speco
Speco.lead: Speco was a planet aligned with the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was ruled by an unnamed Imperial governor, but it was rumored that his mistress, a Falleen named Miaxi, really had control by manipulating him with her charms.

Sibilaari homeworld.title: Sibilaari homeworld
Sibilaari homeworld.lead: The homeworld of the Sibilaari species was located in the Sibilaar system of the Bozhnee sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was destroyed by a cataclysm, and the native Sibilaari survived by creating hardened shelters on the most stable parts of the planet's crust. When the planet was destroyed, the chunks of crust were flung out into space, carrying the shelters with dormant Sibilaari safely inside.

Stobar.title: Stobar/Legends
Stobar.lead: Stobar was a dark and shadowy planet in the Boeus sector of the Expansion Region, and was known for being a very violent planet, for its many criminals.

Storm.title: Storm
Storm.lead: Storm was the father of Hue Tico, who in turn was the father of Paige and Rose Tico.

Suarbi.title: Suarbi
Suarbi.lead: Suarbi was an astronomical object that was located in the Suarbi system in the Quence sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located along a major hyperlane that linked it to the Svivren system.

Talofan.title: Talofan
Talofan.lead: Talofan was the capital planet in the Bajic sector. It was the headquarters of Grand Moff Kintaro.

Trevi IV.title: Trevi IV
Trevi IV.lead: Trevi IV, also known as Trevi, was a dry planet of barren plains and deserts. It was situated along several hyperlanes and lay in the Mid Rim's Quess sector. A Truishii trader starship was forced to land on Trevi IV at some point to make repairs. The Truishii subsequently decided to establish a colony at the landing site, which quickly developed into the large spaceport settlement known as Trevi City. The planet itself eventually became a trade world inhabited by thirty-five million sentients of various species.

Tarabba Prime.title: Tarabba Prime/Legends
Tarabba Prime.lead: Tarabba Prime was a celestial body located in the Tarabba system, a part of the Tarabba sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located on the super-hyperroute known as the Rimma Trade Route, which linked it to the Denab and Tantra systems.

Tirac Munda.title: Tirac Munda
Tirac Munda.lead: Tirac Munda was an astronomical object located in the Tirac Munda system, a part of the Hevvrol sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Human thief Merc Sunlet.

Trigalis.title: Trigalis/Legends
Trigalis.lead: Trigalis was a swamp-covered planet located within the Outer Rim Territories' Juris sector. Long before the Clone Wars, the trading post of New Coronet was founded on Trigalis, but over time the city degenerated into a busy center of various illegal activities.

Tebru.title: Tebru
Tebru.lead: Tebru was a rocky planet that was located within the Tebru system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Juris sector. By the year 3 ABY, the droid inventor and historian Toria Tell maintained a large residence with a workshop and a massive library on the planet. Tell kept her extensive droid collection, which contained many of the galaxy's oldest and rarest robots, at her home. When not traveling off-world aboard her stock light freighter in order to expand her droid collection, the inventor quietly tinkered at her Tebru home.

Triton.title: Triton/Legends

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Sharlissian Trade Corridor

Triton.lead: Triton was a small, almost lifeless planet in the Mayagil sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by the three Triton Moons. The moons were nefariously used by many in the galaxy to describe a dead thing—as dead as a Triton moon, due to the ban of stimulants of any kind.

Tonder.title: Tonder

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Tonder.lead: Tonder was the third planet in the Algaran system. It was a tectonically, seismically active world with incredible mining potential. It boasted one moon. The Algarian Bureau of Planetary Colonization and Bureau of Volcanoes disputed which bureau had jurisdiction over the planet.

Takornan.title: Takornan

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Takornan.lead: Takornan was the fourth planet in the Derilyn system. The planet had two moons and a diversity of fauna and minerals.

Tarastra.title: Tarastra

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Lipsec Run, Nothoiin Corridor, Rimma Trade Route, Senex Trace, Yankirk Route

Tarastra.lead: Tarastra was a gas giant in the Eriadu system, located in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Tarastra was the fifth planet that orbited the star Eriadu, and it was circled by seven moons. Along with the rest of its star system, the planet was located on the hyperspace routes known as the Hydian Way, the Lipsec Run, the Nothoiin Corridor, the Rimma Trade Route, the Senex Trace, and the Yankirk Route.

Tresidiss.title: Tresidiss
Tresidiss.lead: Tresidiss was a planet located in the Tresidiss system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was owned by Herglic criminals who ran massive gambling establishments and usurious banking operations on the planet. As a result of its deliberately lax tariff laws, Tresidiss attracted intelligence agents of every stripe.

Tolig IV.title: Tolig IV
Tolig IV.lead: Tolig IV was a planet located within the Tolig system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Therenor Prime.title: Therenor Prime
Therenor Prime.lead: Therenor Prime was a planet located in the Doldur sector of the Mid Rim. At some point, the protocol droid C-3PO visited Therenor Prime.

Taivas.title: Taivas
Taivas.lead: Taivas was a planet located in the Zhar system, on which the Hidden Temple of the Jedi was built.

Swarquen.title: Swarquen
Swarquen.lead: Swarquen was a planet in the Swarquen system. It was the homeworld of Mol Hedron.

Tregillis.title: Tregillis
Tregillis.lead: Tregillis was a planet located within the Tregillis system of the Expansion Region.

Tears of Zylun.title: Tears of Zylun
Tears of Zylun.lead: Tears of Zylun was an asteroid belt circiling the star Shadda in the Shadda-Bi-Boran system. Located between the planets Shadda-Bi-Boran and Chunno-ka-Alee in the Toblain sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it held the third orbital position.

Tergamenion.title: Tergamenion
Tergamenion.lead: Tergamenion was a planet located in the Grumani sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A darkworld, it served as a base for the Daimanite military industrial complex during the Republic’s Dark Age.

Teirasa.title: Teirasa system/Legends
Teirasa.lead: The Teirasa system was located in the Iskin sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was home to the sentient Teirasan species. During the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, the star system was located outside the borders of the Galactic Republic. When the Republic launched the Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade against the Teirasans in 11,660 BBY, Republic forces advanced toward the Teirasa system from the Kalarba, Ord Dorlass, and Ord Zynthar systems.

Uvena Prime.title: Uvena Prime/Legends
Uvena Prime.lead: Uvena Prime, or Uvena I, was the home planet of the Shistavanens in the Uvena system. The species, capable of hyperspace-level technology, emigrated to other uninhabited worlds of the system, including Uvena III, to prevent strangers from outlying systems from arriving and settling them. As of at least the Galactic Civil War, the planet was led by a monarchy, which made use of the royal Shistavanen Star Cruiser known as the Malachite Scent.

Uvena II.title: Uvena system/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, Eriadu Authority, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation …

Uvena II.lead: The Uvena system was a star system located in the Seswenna sector, and the home system of the Shistavanens, containing the planets of Uvena Prime and Uvena III. It centered around the star Uvena.

Umgul.title: Umgul/Legends
Umgul.lead: Umgul was a mist-covered planet in the Mid Rim. Its capital was Umgul City. The planet's climate was humid and cool, while dense fog and deep hanging clouds were almost omnipresent. Though it was once a conquest of the Infinite Empire, the planet's natural resources were of no relevance and it was of little strategical importance. Nevertheless, the planet was famous throughout the galaxy as a center for gambling and sports attractions, most notably the Umgullian Blob Racing.

Vandelhelm.title: Vandelhelm/Legends

facts.population: 40 million (90% Humans, 6% Sullustans, 4% assorted alien species)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Vandelhelm.lead: Vandelhelm was a planet located in the Vandelhelm system, inside of the Vandelhelm Cloud within the Expansion Region. It was known for its starshipwrights, and manufacturing capabilities.

Uvena III.title: Uvena III
Uvena III.lead: Uvena III was a Shistavanen colony planet located within the Uvena system of the Outer Rim Territories. Expatriates of Uvena III included Mal Biron, Caet Shrovl, and Riv Shiel.

Tyluun.title: Tyluun
Tyluun.lead: Tyluun was a gloomy planet located in the Tyluun system of the Juvex sector. It was the homeworld of the Night-Soarers.

Vactooine.title: Vactooine
Vactooine.lead: Vactooine was a mining colony in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its dense jungles made it a suitable habitat for the Elix.

Vandelhelm Cloud.title: Vandelhelm Cloud
Vandelhelm Cloud.lead: The Vandelhelm Cloud was a vast asteroid field that encompassed the Vandelhelm system in the Expansion Region's Epsi Collective. The Vandelhelm Cloud was thick enough that the planet Vandelhelm, though extremely rich in valuable metals, was not discovered until the relatively late date of approximately 3053 BBY. The cloud's asteroids were so thick and unpredictable that it was reputed to take an ace pilot to navigate it.

Tshindral III.title: Tshindral III

facts.region: Mid Rim, Trailing Sectors, Western Reaches

Tshindral III.lead: Tshindral III was a Mid Rim planetoid near the Outer Rim with a scant, toxic atmosphere which could corrode a freighter's hulls in less than a local day. It was orbited by Starlyte Station. Imperial experiments on the station had destroyed the ecosystem of the once-tropical planet below. Tshindral III had a local day 25 standard hours long and a year 300 local days long.

Turak IV.title: Turak IV
Turak IV.lead: Turak IV was a planet located within the Turak system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Turcan III.title: Turcan III
Turcan III.lead: Turcan III was a planet located within the Turcan system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the headquarters of the mercenary company known as Churhee's Riflemen.

Tytun.title: Tytun
Tytun.lead: Tytun was a gas giant, the fifth planet in the Gacerian system. It had eight moons.

Tun.title: Tun
Tun.lead: Tun was an arid planet of rocky wastes. It was the first planet in the Gacerian system. It had no moons.

Vedis IV.title: Vedis IV
Vedis IV.lead: Vedis IV was a planet located in the Vedis system, which was part of the Mayagil sector in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. Around 3 BBY, the smuggler Toob Ancher was known to have left Soco-Jarel Spaceport with the YT-1300 transport Glory to reach the planet. Vedis IV was also where another smuggler named Lu Esi died when he crashed his freighter into the planet while being chased by sector authorities.

Velga.title: Velga Prime
Velga.lead: Velga Prime, also known as Velga, and sometimes known as the Gamblers' Moon, was a moon located within the Velga system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.

U'Dray.title: U'Dray
U'Dray.lead: U'Dray was a planet situated in the U'Dray system of the Hook Nebula, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. As part of the Galactic Civil War's Hook Nebula campaign waged at some point by the time shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the Qeimet fleet of the Galactic Empire carried out an assault at U'Dray. The Rebel Alliance initially achieved a rare victory over the fleet's Scimitar assault wing, although the Empire nevertheless ultimately prevailed in the engagement.

Velanaria.title: Velanaria
Velanaria.lead: Velanaria was a planet located within the Velanaria system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tuerto.title: Tuerto
Tuerto.lead: Tuerto was a planet located within the Tuerto system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Undar.title: Undar
Undar.lead: Undar was an airless terrestrial planet in the Dagobah system, located in the Outer Rim Territories' Sluis sector. It occupied the third orbital position around the star Darlo and had two moons. Along with the rest of the star system, Undar was situated on the hyperlane known as the Rimma Trade Route.

Vellas Pavo.title: Vellas Pavo
Vellas Pavo.lead: Vellas Pavo was a planet that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. Before and during the Republic Dark Age the world was a known source of gadolinium.

Xagobah.title: Xagobah/Legends

facts.terrain: Fungal forests, Swamps, Mountains, Jungles, Deserts
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Xagobah.lead: Xagobah was a planet located in the Xagobah system, just inside the border with the Outer Rim Territories, and was the homeworld of the Xamster race.

Verisin.title: Verisin
Verisin.lead: Verisin was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bajic sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Tenloss Coalition, a criminal organization specializing in contract kidnapping.

Virmeude.title: Virmeude

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Virmeude.lead: Virmeude was a planet in the Mayagil sector. It was the headquarters of Issham Mining Corporation, which was actually a cover for a Rebel Alliance base.

Vogel 7.title: Vogel 7

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Vogel 7.lead: Vogel 7 was a low-gravity planet in the Vogel system of the Mid Rim.

Vondarc.title: Vondarc/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Eriadu Authority

Vondarc.lead: Vondarc was a planet located within the Vondarc system of the Mid Rim, that served as one of the endpoints of the Enarc Run hyperroute.

Woostri.title: Woostri/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Eriadu Authority, New Republic

Woostri.lead: Woostri was a planet in the Expansion Region known for its HoloScan Database, tourism, and automated manufacturing.

Vorusku.title: Vorusku
Vorusku.lead: Vorusku was a waterworld located within the Outer Rim Territories' Juris sector. It was the site of a volcano city as well as a floating bar named the Hyperdrive Cantina. The Kaminoan Jedi Kina Ha once lived on Vorusku. While there, she had a vision of the future in which the cloners of the planet Kamino would create an army for the dark side of the Force.

Vessar Asteroid Field.title: Vessar Asteroid Field
Vessar Asteroid Field.lead: Vessar Asteroid Field was an asteroid field located within the Telanka system of the Outer Rim Territories that included Buula's Rocky Home.

Widow.title: Widow
Widow.lead: Widow was the fourth planet in the Naboo system. It had one moon.

Vohai.title: Vohai
Vohai.lead: Vohai was a planet located within the Vohai system of the Outer Rim Territories, covered with industrial sites, that were interspersed with residential towers and parkland. The Vohai Unirail encircled the entire planet from pole to pole, two kilometers above the planet's surface. The Arkanian company Arkanian Microtechnologies's headquarters were on Vohai.

Vendrak V.title: Vendrak V
Vendrak V.lead: Vendrak V was an astronomical object that occupied the fifth orbital position in the Vendrak system. The system was located in the Videnda sector of the Outer Rim Territories in the Western Reaches. Vendrak V was the site of a starport that featured at least one large hangar.

Vergesso Asteroids.title: Vergesso Asteroids/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Tenloss Criminal Syndicate

Vergesso Asteroids.lead: The Vergesso Asteroids, also known as the Vergesso Asteroid Field, were located in the Lybeya system of the Outer Rim Territories's Bajic sector.

Wei.title: Wei
Wei.lead: Wei was the second planet in the Gacerian system. It was a world of arid, rocky wastes with no moons.

Vulcar.title: Vulcar
Vulcar.lead: Vulcar was a baleful orange, sulfurous planet located in the Vulcar system, within the Juvex sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim in the Western Reaches. A hyperlane branching off the Senex-Juvex Loop connected it to the worlds of Tinallis and Tyluun. Home to the eponymous Sulphur Pits of Vulcar, its acrid atmosphere made employing humanoid workers to extract the world's oridium deposits barely cost-effective. Instead, Vulcar was primarily worked by droids of all types, including crab droids, reprogrammed to serve as miners until they froze up and rusted into scrap.

Wranag.title: Wranag
Wranag.lead: Wranag was a planet located within the Wranag system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vinzen Neela 5.title: Vinzen Neela 5
Vinzen Neela 5.lead: Vinzen Neela 5 was an astronomical object located within the Vinzen Neela system of the Outer Rim Territories' Parmic sector. In 3 ABY, following the Battle of Hoth, the cargo ferry group Sela was set to rendezvous with the Ton-Falk-class escort carrier Hininbirg near Vinzen Neela 5 to transfer the Galactic Empire's TIE/D Defender prototypes that the former was carrying. Rebel Alliance forces arrived in the area before the Imperial starships could in an attempt to ambush them and disrupt the transfer. In response, Imperial starfighters were dispatched to protect the transfer operation.

Whinndor.title: Whinndor
Whinndor.lead: Whinndor was a world that was located in the Grumani sector. It had a sulphuric atmosphere and seas that were abundant with organic molecules. During the Republic Dark Age the planet was located in a Sith-contested space, with the mercenary Rusher's Brigade once fighting on its surface. The Whinndorian gorsk-plant was a plant species native to Whinndor.

Ventruun.title: Ventruun
Ventruun.lead: Ventruun was a Grumani world in the Grumani sector that was located on the Hydian Way and was noted for canny merchants and frenzied deal-making.

Watassay.title: Watassay
Watassay.lead: Watassay was a small, inhabitable planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. At some point, the Galactic Empire enacted a blockade around it, wanting to claim the resources there. Furthermore, they attempted to starve the citizens of the planet. In 1 BBY, Blue's partisans traveled to Watassay with crates of foodstuffs for the people, with the crew helping to unload the supplies before distributing it though a small makeshift town.

Vergesso.title: Vergesso Prime
Vergesso.lead: Vergesso Prime, or simply Vergesso, was an asteroid in the Outer Rim Territories' Lybeya system. It was the site of a shadowport with an outfitter that was visited by the smuggler Tryphon Leo on recommendation by the former pirate queen Maz Kanata. By 2 BBY, the asteroid also saw activity from both the Mining Guild and Senator Mon Mothma's organized rebellion.

Z'trop.title: Z'trop
Z'trop.lead: Z'trop was a planet located in the Tamarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Yasilor.title: Yasilor
Yasilor.lead: Yasilor was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bajic sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Palkandi Brokerage House, a front organization for the criminal Tenloss Syndicate.

Zolan.title: Zolan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Zolan.lead: Zolan was a planet that was the homeworld of the Zolander species and its Clawdite offshoot.

Zelos II.title: Zelos II
Zelos II.lead: Zelos II was the second planet of the Zelos system. It was aligned with the Galactic Empire and was an important source of ores for the Imperial war machine. It was also the homeworld of the Zelosians. The Bare Forest, otherwise known as the Forest of the Walking Dead, was located in the mountains at the far north of the northern continent. The planet was orbited by four moons.

Zhotta 3.title: Zhotta 3
Zhotta 3.lead: Zhotta 3 was a planet located in the Zhotta system of the Outer Rim Territories' Mayagil sector. After the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance sent Han Solo and Chewbacca to invite the planetary leaders of this world to a congress to determine the fate of the galaxy.

ZeHeth.title: ZeHeth/Legends

facts.region: Wild Space (c. 12,000 BBY–11,000 BBY), Mid Rim, Trailing Sectors

ZeHeth.lead: ZeHeth was a Mid Rim planet that was home to the sentient ZeHethbra species. The natives of ZeHeth lived in urban areas as well as in dens amid the roots of the planet's large trees. ZeHeth was a part of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars and became a member of the Galactic Empire afterward.

Yarnil.title: Yarnil
Yarnil.lead: Yarnil was a planet located within the Yarnil system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a homeworld to farmers and merchants.

Yetoom Na Uun.title: Yetoom Na Uun
Yetoom Na Uun.lead: Yetoom Na Uun was a planet located within the Yetoom system of the Senex sector. Positioned at the sector's edge, Yetoom was a shadowport controlled by gangs of Senex-Juvex slave species, and was the headquarters of Fargednim P'taan. It was often visited by disreputable nobles from the Senex and Juvex Houses.

Y'Trella.title: Y'Trella
Y'Trella.lead: Y'Trella was a planet located within the Y'Trella system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Xandil VII.title: Xandil VII
Xandil VII.lead: Xandil VII was an astronomical object located in the Xandil system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It shared its name with the Far Xandil sector, which bordered the Lambda sector in 0 ABY.

Xiunsrus.title: Xiunsrus
Xiunsrus.lead: Xiunsrus was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Xiunsrus system, a part of the Quence sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A small farming village was located there.

Yeshocq.title: Yeshocq
Yeshocq.lead: Yeshocq was a planet located within the Yeshocq system of the Mid Rim. It was a colonized, forested, temperate planet with a local year that lasted 13 standard months: the local year was divided into 455 local days. Yeshocq was the homeworld qormot species.

Yityl.title: Yityl
Yityl.lead: Yityl was a planet located within the Yityl system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was an Imperial planet inhabited by Humans such as Imperial Customs Agent Hewat and her daughter Kora.

Yuga 2.title: Yuga 2
Yuga 2.lead: Yuga 2 was the second planet in the Yuga system. It was covered in rain forests. The world played host to the popular Yuga Planetary Park, a tourist destination visited by Galaxy Tours. It was the site of a raid on a Galaxy Tours cruiser by Callow Batta prior to the Battle of Hoth.

Zissh.title: Zissh
Zissh.lead: Zissh was a planet located within the Zissh system of the Expansion Region. It was a frozen world where Jedi Knight Aven Rolk planned to establish a new Jedi Temple and rebuild the Jedi Order. However, his proclamation drew the attention of the Galactic Empire, and Rolk was later found dead in an ice cave.
